sanskrit_transliteration: Swāminārāyaṇah sākshād Akshara-Purushottamaha; Sarvebhyah paramām shāntim ānandam sukham arpayet.
gujarati_transliteration: Swaminarayan Bhagwan etle ke sākshāt Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj sarvane param shānti, ānand ane sukh arpe. (1)
english_translation: May Swaminarayan Bhagwan, who is Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj himself,1 bestow ultimate peace, bliss and happiness on all. (1)

sanskrit_transliteration: Deho’yam sādhanam mukter na bhoga-mātra-sādhanam; Durlabho nashvarash-chā’yam vāram-vāram na labhyate.
gujarati_transliteration: Ā deh muktinu sādhan chhe, keval bhognu sādhan nathi. Durlabh ane nāshvant evo ā deh vāramvār malto nathi. (2)
english_translation: This body is a means for moksha, not merely a means for indulgence [in sense pleasures]. Rare and perishable, this body is not repeatedly attained. (2)

sanskrit_transliteration: Laukiko vyavahāras-tu deha-nirvāha-hetukaha; Naiva sa paramam lakshyam asya manushya-janmanaha.
gujarati_transliteration: Laukik vyavahār to dehnā nirvāh māte chhe. Te ā manushya janmanu param lakshya nathi. (3)
english_translation: Personal and family activities are [only] for the sustenance of the body. They are not the ultimate objective of this human birth. (3)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Nāshāya sarva-doshāṇām brahma-sthiter avāptaye; Kartum Bhagavato bhaktim asya dehasya lambhanam.
Sarvam idam hi satsangāl- labhyate nishchitam janaihi; Atah sadaiva satsangah karaṇīyo mumukshubhihi.
gujarati_transliteration: Sarva doshone tālvā, brahma-sthitine pāmvā ane Bhagwanni bhakti karvā ā deh malyo chhe. Ā badhu satsang karvāthi avashya prāpta thāy chhe. Āthi mumu kshuoe sadāy satsang karvo. (4–5)
english_translation: This body has been received to eradicate all flaws, attain the brāhmic state and offer devotion to Bhagwan. All this is certainly attained by practising satsang.2 Therefore, mumukshus should always practise satsang. (4–5)

sanskrit_transliteration: Satsangah sthāpitas-tasmād divyo’yam Parabrahmaṇā; Swāminārāyaṇeneha sākshād evā’vatīrya cha.
gujarati_transliteration: Tethi Parabrahma Swaminarayane ā lokmā sākshāt avtarine ā divya satsangni sthāpnā kari. (6)
english_translation: For this reason, Parabrahma Swaminarayan himself manifested in this world and established this divine Satsang. (6)

sanskrit_transliteration: Satsangasyā’sya vignānam mumukshūṇām bhaved iti; Shāstram Satsanga-Dīksheti shubhā’shayād virachyate.
gujarati_transliteration: Ā satsangnu jnān mumukshuone thāy evā shubh āshaythi ‘Satsang Diksha’ e nāmnu shāstra rachvāmā āve chhe. (7)
english_translation: The shastra titled ‘Satsang Diksha’ has been composed with the pure intent that mumukshus acquire the knowledge of this satsang. (7)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Satyasya svātmanah sangah satyasya Paramātmanaha; Satyasya cha guroh sangah sach-chhāstrāṇām tathaiva cha.
Vignātavyam idam satyam satsangasya hi lakshaṇam; Kurvan-nevam vidham divyam satsangam syāt sukhī janaha.
gujarati_transliteration: Satya evā ātmāno sang karvo, satya evā Paramatmano sang karvo, satya evā guruno sang karvo ane sach-chhāstrano sang karvo e satsangnu sāchu lakshan jānvu. Āvo divya satsang karnār manushya sukhi thāy chhe. (8–9)
english_translation: One should know that the true meaning of satsang is to associate with the ātmā, which is true; to associate with Paramatma, who is true; to associate with the guru, who is true; and to associate with true shastras. One who practises this divine satsang becomes blissful. (8–9)

sanskrit_transliteration: Dīksheti draḍha-sankalpah sa-shraddham nishchayo’chalaha; Samyak samarpaṇam prītyā nishṭhā vratam draḍhāshrayaha.
gujarati_transliteration: Dikshā etle dradh sankalp, shraddhāe sahit evo achal nishchay, samyak samarpan, priti- purvak nishthā, vrat ane dradh āshro. (10)
english_translation: ‘Diksha’ means firm resolve, unwavering conviction coupled with faith, absolute dedication, loving faith, observances and firm refuge. (10)

sanskrit_transliteration: Shāstre’smin gnāpitā spashṭam āgnopāsana-paddhatihi; Paramātma-Parabrahma- Sahajānanda-darshitā.
gujarati_transliteration: Ā shāstramā Parabrahma Sahajanand Paramatmae darshāvel āgnā tathā upāsanāni paddhatine spashta rite janāvi chhe. (11)
english_translation: The methods of āgnā and upāsanā revealed by Parabrahma Sahajanand Paramatma are clearly expressed in this shastra. (11)

sanskrit_transliteration: Satsangā’dhikrutah sarve sarve sukhā’dhi-kāriṇaha; Sarve’rhā brahmavidyāyām nāryash-chaiva narās-tathā.
gujarati_transliteration: Purusho tathā strio sarve satsangnā adhikāri chhe, sarve sukhnā adhikāri chhe ane sarve brahmavidyānā adhikāri chhe. (12)
english_translation: All males and females are entitled to satsang, all are entitled to happiness and all are entitled to brahmavidyā. (12)

sanskrit_transliteration: Naiva nyūnādhikatvam syāt satsange linga-bhedataha; Sva-sva-maryādayā sarve bhaktyā muktim samāpnuyuhu.
gujarati_transliteration: Satsangmā ling-bhedthi nyun-ādhikpanu na ja samajvu. Badhā pot-potāni maryādāmā rahi bhakti vade muktine pāmi shake chhe. (13)
english_translation: In Satsang, superiority or inferiority should never be understood to be based on gender. All can attain moksha through devotion while observing the dharma prescribed for them. (13)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Sarva-varṇa-gatāh sarvā nāryah sarve narās-tathā; Satsange brahmavidyāyām mokshe sadā’dhikāriṇaha.
Na nyūnā’dhikatā kāryā varṇā’dhāreṇa karhichit; Tyaktvā sva-varṇa-mānam cha sevā kāryā mithah samaihi.
Jātyā naiva mahān ko’pi naiva nyūnas-tathā yataha; Jātyā klesho na kartavyah sukham satsangam ācharet.
gujarati_transliteration: Sarva varnanā sarva strio tathā sarva purusho sadāy satsang, brahmavidyā ane mokshanā adhikāri chhe. Varnanā ādhāre kyārey nyun- ādhikbhāv na karvo. Sarva janoe potānā varnanu mān tyajine paraspar sevā karvi. Jātie karine koi mahān nathi ane koi nyun pan nathi. Tethi nāt-jātne laine klesh na karvo ne sukhe satsang karvo. (14–16)
english_translation: All men and women of all castes are forever entitled to satsang, brahmavidyā and moksha. Do not attribute notions of superiority and inferiority based on varna. All persons should shun their ego based on their caste and serve one another. No one is superior and no one is inferior by birth. Therefore, one should not quarrel based on caste or class and should joyfully practise satsang. (14–16)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sarve’dhikāriṇo mokshe gruhiṇas-tyāgino’pi cha; Na nyūnā’dhikatā tatra sarve bhaktā yatah Prabhoho.
gujarati_transliteration: Gruhastha tathā tyāgi sarve mokshanā adhikāri chhe. Temā nyun-ādhikbhāv nathi, kāran ke gruhastha ke tyāgi badhā Bhagwannā bhakto chhe. (17)
english_translation: Householders and renunciants are all entitled to moksha. Between them neither is inferior nor superior, because householders and renunciants are all devotees of Bhagwan. (17)

sanskrit_transliteration: Swāminārāyaṇe’nanya- draḍha-parama-bhaktaye; Gruhītvā’shraya-dīkshāyā mantram satsangam āpnuyāt.
gujarati_transliteration: Swaminarayan Bhagwanne vishe ananya, dradh ane param bhakti māte Ashray Diksha Mantra grahan kari satsang prāpta karvo. (18)
english_translation: To offer singular, resolute and supreme devotion to Bhagwan Swaminarayan, one should receive the Ashray Diksha Mantra3 and affiliate with the Satsang. (18)

sanskrit_transliteration: Dhanyo’smi pūrṇakāmo’smi nishpāpo nirbhayah sukhī; Akshara-guru-yogena Swāminārāyaṇā’shrayāt.
gujarati_transliteration: Ashray Diksha Mantra ā pramāne chhe: Dhanyo’smi purna-kāmo’smi nishpāpo nirbhayah sukhi; Akshara-guru-yogena Swāminārāyan-āshrayāt. (19)
english_translation: The Ashray Diksha Mantra is as follows: Dhanyo’smi purna-kāmo’smi nishpāpo nirbhayah sukhi; Akshara-guru-yogena Swāminārāyan-āshrayāt.4 (19)

sanskrit_transliteration: Āshrayet Sahajānandam Harim Brahmā’ksharam tathā; Guṇātītam gurum prītyā mumukshuh svātma-muktaye.
gujarati_transliteration: Mumukshu potānā ātmāni mukti māte Sahajanand Shri Hari tathā Akshar- brahmaswarup Gunatit guruno pritie karine āshro kare. (20)
english_translation: For the moksha of one’s ātmā, a mumukshu should lovingly take refuge of Sahajanand Shri Hari and the Aksharbrahma Gunatit guru.5 (20)

sanskrit_transliteration: Kāshṭha-jām dvi-guṇām mālām kaṇṭhe sadaiva dhārayet; Satsangam hi samāshritya satsanga-niyamāns-tathā.
gujarati_transliteration: Satsangno āshro kari sadāy kanthne vishe kāshthani bevdi mālā dhāran karvi tathā satsangnā niyamo dhāran karvā. (21)
english_translation: Upon taking the refuge of satsang, one should always wear a double-stranded wooden kanthi around the neck and accept the niyams of satsang. (21)

sanskrit_transliteration: Gurum Brahmaswarūpam tu vinā na sambhaved bhave; Tattvato brahmavidyāyāh sākshātkāro hi jīvane.
gujarati_transliteration: Ā sansārmā brahmaswarup guru vinā jivanmā brahmavidyāno tattve karine sākshātkār na thai shake. (22)
english_translation: In this world, brahmavidyā cannot be fully realized in life without the Brahmaswarup guru.6 (22)

sanskrit_transliteration: Nottamo nirvikalpash-cha nishchayah Paramātmanaha; Na svātma-brahma-bhāvo’pi Brahmā’ksharam gurum vinā.
gujarati_transliteration: Aksharbrahma guru vinā Paramatmano uttam nirvikalp nishchay na thai shake tathā potānā ātmāne vishe brahmabhāv pan prāpta na thai shake. (23)
english_translation: Without the Aksharbrahma guru, supreme, unwavering conviction (nishchay) in Paramatma cannot be attained and one’s ātmā also cannot acquire brahmabhāv. (23)

sanskrit_transliteration: Naivā’pi tattvato bhaktih paramānanda-prāpaṇam; Nā’pi trividha-tāpānām nāsho Brahma-gurum vinā.
gujarati_transliteration: Brahmaswarup guru vinā yathārth bhakti pan na thai shake, param ānandni prāpti na thāy ane trividh tāpno nāsh pan na thāy. (24)
english_translation: Without the Brahmaswarup guru, perfect devotion also cannot be offered, ultimate bliss cannot be attained and the three types of miseries7 also cannot be eradicated. (24)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sarva-siddhi-karam divyam Paramātmā’nubhāvakam.
gujarati_transliteration: Āthi sarva arthni siddhi kare tathā Paramatmano anubhav karāve tevā pratyaksha Aksharbrahma guruno āshro sadāy karvo. (25)
english_translation: Therefore, one should always take the refuge of the manifest Aksharbrahma guru, who enables one to attain all objectives and experience Paramatma. (25)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sarvam dur-vyasanam tyājyam sarvaih satsangibhih sadā; Aneka-roga-dukhānām kāraṇam vyasanam yataha.
gujarati_transliteration: Sarva satsangioe sarve dur-vyasanono sadāy tyāg karvo. Kāran ke vyasan anek rogonu tathā dukhonu kāran bane chhe. (26)
english_translation: All satsangis should always renounce all harmful addictions, as addictions cause numerous illnesses and miseries. (26)

sanskrit_transliteration: Surā-bhangā-tamālādi yad yad bhaveddhi mādakam; Tad bhakshayet piben-naiva dhūmra-pānam api tyajet.
gujarati_transliteration: Surā, bhāng tathā tamāku ityādi je je padārtho mādak hoy te kyārey khāvā ke pivā nahi tathā dhumrapānno pan tyāg karvo. (27)
english_translation: One should never consume intoxicating substances, such as alcohol, bhang and tobacco. One should also refrain from smoking. (27)

sanskrit_transliteration: Pari-tyājyam sadā dyūtam sarvaih sarva-prakārakam; Tyaktavyo vyabhichārash-cha nārībhih purushais-tathā.
gujarati_transliteration: Sarve stri tathā purushoe sarva prakārnā jugārno tathā vyabhichārno tyāg karvo. (28)
english_translation: All women and men should never engage in any form of gambling or adultery. (28)

sanskrit_transliteration: Mānsam matsyam tathā’ṇḍāni bhakshayeyur na karhichit; Palāṇḍum lashunam hingu na cha satsangino janāhā.
gujarati_transliteration: Satsangi janoe kyārey māns, māchhli, indā tathā dungli, lasan, hing na khāvā. (29)
english_translation: Satsangis should never eat meat, fish, eggs, onions, garlic or hing. (29)

sanskrit_transliteration: Pātavyam gālitam peyam jalam dugdhādikam tathā; Khādyam pānam ashuddham yad grahṇīyād vastu tan-nahi.
gujarati_transliteration: Pāni tathā dudh ityādi peya padārtho gālelā grahan karvā. Je khādya vastu tathā pinā ashuddha hoy te kyārey grahan na karvā. (30)
english_translation: One should consume water, milk and other drinkable items [only] after they have been filtered. Food items and beverages that are forbidden should never be consumed. (30)

sanskrit_transliteration: Chauryam na karhichit kāryam satsangam āshritair janaihi; Dharmārtham api no kāryam chora-kāryam tu karhichit.
gujarati_transliteration: Satsangioe chori kyārey na karvi. Dharmane arthe pan chori kyārey na karvi. (31)
english_translation: Satsangis should never steal. Even for the sake of dharma, one should never commit theft. (31)

sanskrit_transliteration: Naivā’nya-svāmikam grāhyam tad-anugnām vinā svayam; Pushpa-falādyapi vastu sūkshma-chauryam tad uchyate.
gujarati_transliteration: Pushpa, falo jevi vastu pan tenā dhanini parvāngi vagar na levi. Parvāngi vagar levu te sukshma chori kahevāy chhe. (32)
english_translation: One should never take even objects such as flowers or fruits without the consent of their owners. Taking without consent is a subtle form of theft. (32)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Manushyāṇām pashūnām vā matkuṇādesh-cha pakshiṇām; Keshānchij-jīva-jantūnām hinsā kāryā na karhichit.
Ahinsā paramo dharmo hinsā tvadharma-rūpiṇī; Shruti-smrutyādi-shāstreshu sfuṭam evam prakīrtitam.
gujarati_transliteration: Kyārey manushya, pashu, pakshi, tathā mākad ādik koi pan jiva-jantuoni hinsā na karvi. Ahinsā param dharma chhe, hinsā adharma chhe em Shruti-Smruti-ādi shāstromā spashta kahevāmā āvyu chhe. (33–34)
english_translation: One should never kill humans, animals, birds and bugs or other insects and creatures. The Shrutis, Smrutis and other sacred texts clearly describe non-violence as the highest dharma and violence as adharma. (33–34)

sanskrit_transliteration: Yāgārtham apyajādīnām nirdoshāṇām hi prāṇinām; Hinsanam naiva kartavyam satsangibhih kadāchana.
gujarati_transliteration: Satsangioe yagnane arthe pan bakrā vagere nirdosh prānioni hinsā kyārey na ja karvi. (35)
english_translation: Even for a yagna, satsangis should never harm goats or any other innocent animals. (35)

sanskrit_transliteration: Yāgādike cha kartavye siddhāntam sāmpradāyikam; Anusrutya hi kartavyam hinsā-rahitam eva tat.
gujarati_transliteration: Yāgādi karvānā thāy tyāre Sampradaynā siddhāntne anusarine hinsā rahit ja karvā. (36)
english_translation: When yagnas are held, they should only be conducted without harming any beings and according to the Sampradaya’s principles. (36)

sanskrit_transliteration: Matvā’pi yagna-shesham cha vā’pi deva-niveditam; Mānsam kadāpi bhakshyam na satsangam āshritair janaihi.
gujarati_transliteration: Yagnano shesh ganine ke pachhi devtānā naivedya rupe pan satsangioe kyārey māns na ja khāvu. (37)
english_translation: Satsangis should never eat meat, even if it is considered to be the remnant of a yagna or sanctified by the deities. (37)

sanskrit_transliteration: Kasyā’pi tāḍanam naiva karaṇīyam kadāchana; Apa-shabdā’pamānādi sūkshma-hinsā’pi naiva cha.
gujarati_transliteration: Koinu tādan kyārey na karvu. Apshabdo kahevā, apmān karvu ityādi koipan prakāre sukshma hinsā pan na karvi. (38)
english_translation: One should never strike another person. One should not swear, insult or commit other forms of subtle harm or injury. (38)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sattā-kīrti-dhana-dravya- strī-purushādikā’ptaye; Mānershyā-krodhatash-chā’pi hinsām naiva samācharet.
gujarati_transliteration: Dhan, sattā, kirti, stri, purush ityādini prāptine arthe tathā mān, irshā ke krodhe karine pan hinsā na karvi. (39)
english_translation: One should not commit violence to attain wealth, power, prestige or [to fulfil one’s desire] for a man or woman or anything else. Also, one should not commit violence out of ego, jealousy or anger. (39)

sanskrit_transliteration: Manasā vachasā vā’pi karmaṇā hinsane krute; Tat-sthito dukhyate nūnam Swāminārāyaṇo Harihi.
gujarati_transliteration: Mane karine, vachane karine ke karme karine hinsā karvāthi tenāmā rahelā Swaminarayan Bhagwan dukhāy chhe. (40)
english_translation: Inflicting mental, verbal or physical violence pains Swaminarayan Bhagwan, who resides within that person. (40)

sanskrit_transliteration: Ātma-ghāto’pi hinsaiva na kāryo’tah kadāchana; Patana-gala-bandhādyair visha-bhakshādibhis-tathā.
gujarati_transliteration: Ātmahatyā karvi te pan hinsā ja chhe. Āthi padtu mukvu, gale tupo khāvo, jher khāvu ityādi koi rite ātmahatyā kyārey na karvi. (41)
english_translation: Suicide is also a form of violence. Therefore, never commit suicide by falling from heights, hanging oneself, consuming poison or any other means. (41)

sanskrit_transliteration: Dukha-lajjā-bhaya-krodha- rogādyāpatti kāraṇāt; Dharmā’rtham api kashchiddhi hanyān-na svam na vā param.
gujarati_transliteration: Dukh, lajjā, bhay, krodh tathā rog ityādi āpattine kārane, ke pachhi dharmane arthe pan koie potāni ke anyani hatyā na karvi. (42)
english_translation: No one should kill oneself or others out of grief, shame, fear, anger or due to illness and other adversities, not even for the sake of dharma. (42)

sanskrit_transliteration: Tīrthe’pi naiva kartavya ātma-ghāto mumukshubhihi; Naivā’pi moksha-puṇyāpti bhāvāt kāryah sa tatra cha.
gujarati_transliteration: Mumukshue tirthne vishe pan ātmahatyā na ja karvi. Moksha ke punya pāmvāni bhāvnāthi pan tirthne vishe āpghāt na ja karvo. (43)
english_translation: A mumukshu should never commit suicide even at a place of pilgrimage. One should never commit suicide at pilgrimage places even with the hope of attaining moksha or merits. (43)

sanskrit_transliteration: Bhagavān sarva-kartā’sti dayāluh sarva-rakshakaha; Sa eva nāshakah sarva- sankaṭānām sadā mama.
gujarati_transliteration: Bhagwan sarva-kartā chhe, dayālu chhe, sarvanu rakshan karnārā chhe ane e ja sadā mārā sarve sankatonā tālnārā chhe. (44)
english_translation: Bhagwan is the all-doer, compassionate and the protector of all; at all times, he alone is the resolver of all my adversities. (44)

sanskrit_transliteration: Bhagavān kurute yaddhi hitārtham eva tat sadā; Prārabdham me tad ichchhaiva sa eva tārako mama.
gujarati_transliteration: Bhagwan je kare te sadāy sārā māte hoy. Temni ichchhā e ja māru prārabdha chhe. Teo ja mārā tārak chhe. (45)
english_translation: Whatever Bhagwan does is always benefi- cial. His wish alone is my prārabdha. He alone is my liberator. (45)

sanskrit_transliteration: Nūnam nankshyanti me vighnāh pāpa-doshāsh-cha dur-guṇāhā; Nūnam prāpsyāmyaham shāntim ānandam paramam sukham.
gujarati_transliteration: Mārā vighno, pāp, dosh tathā durguno avashya nāsh pāmshe. Hu avashya shānti, param ānand ane sukh pāmish. (46)
english_translation: My hindrances, sins, flaws and bad qualities will certainly be destroyed. I will surely attain peace, supreme bliss and happiness. (46)

sanskrit_transliteration: Yato mām militah sākshād Akshara-Purushottamaha; Nishchayena tarishyāmi dukha-jātam hi tad balāt.
gujarati_transliteration: Kāran ke mane sākshāt Akshar- Purushottam Maharaj malyā chhe. Temnā bale hu jarur dukhne tari jaish. (47)
english_translation: This is because I have attained the manifest form of Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj. With his strength, I will surely overcome misery. (47)

sanskrit_transliteration: Vichāryaivam balam rakshed nā’shrito nirbalo bhavet; Ānandito bhaven-nityam Bhagavad bala vaibhavāt.
gujarati_transliteration: Ā rite vichārnu bal rākhi āshrit bhakta kyārey himmat na hāre ane Bhagwannā bale ānandmā rahe. (48)
english_translation: With the strength of such thoughts, a devotee who has taken refuge never loses courage and remains joyous due to the strength of Bhagwan. (48)

sanskrit_transliteration: Shṭhīvanam mala-mūtrādi- visarjanam sthaleshu cha; Shāstra-loka-nishiddheshu na kartavyam kadāchana.
gujarati_transliteration: Shāstramā tathā lokmā nishedh karyo hoy tevā sthānone vishe kyārey thukvu nahi tathā mal-mutrādi na karvu. (49)
english_translation: One should never spit, urinate or defaecate in places prohibited by the shastras and society. (49)

sanskrit_transliteration: Shuddhih sarvavidhā pālyā bāhyā chā’bhyantarā sadā; Shuddhi-priyah prasīdech-cha shuddhi-mati jane Harihi.
gujarati_transliteration: Bāhya ane āntarik em sarva prakārni shud- dhinu pālan karvu. Shri Harine shuddhi priya chhe ane shuddhivālā manushyani upar teo prasanna thāy chhe. (50)
english_translation: One should observe all forms of external and internal purity. Shri Hari8 loves purity and is pleased with those who are pure. (50)

sanskrit_transliteration: Satsangibhih praboddhavyam pūrvam sūryodayāt sadā; Tatah snānādikam krutvā dhartavyam shuddha vastrakam.
gujarati_transliteration: Satsangioe sadā surya ugyā purve jāgvu. Tyārbād snānādik kari shuddha vastro dhāran karvā. (51)
english_translation: Satsangis should always wake up before sunrise. After bathing and other morning routines, they should put on clean clothes. (51)

sanskrit_transliteration: Pūrvasyām uttarasyām vā dishi krutvā mukham tataha; Shuddhā’sanopavishṭah san- nitya-pūjām samācharet.
gujarati_transliteration: Tyārbād purva dishāmā athvā uttar dishāmā mukh rākhi, shuddha āsan upar besi nitya-pujā karvi. (52)
english_translation: Thereafter, one should sit on a clean āsan and perform personal daily puja facing east or north. (52)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Prabhu-pūjopa-yuktena chandanenordhva puṇḍrakam; Bhāle hi tilakam kuryāt kumkumena cha chandrakam.
Urasi hastayosh-chandram tilakam chandanena cha; Swāminārāyaṇam mantram japan kuryād gurum smaran.
gujarati_transliteration: Swaminarayan mantrano jāp kartā tathā gurunu smaran kartā kartā bhālne vishe Bhagwanni pujāthi prasādi-bhut thayel chandan vade urdhva-pundra tilak karvu ane kumkum vade chāndlo karvo tathā chhāti ane banne bhujāo par chandanthi tilak-chāndlo karvo. (53–54)
english_translation: While chanting the Swaminarayan mantra and remembering the guru, apply a U-shaped tilak made from chandan that has been sanctified by having been offered to Bhagwan and a kumkum chāndlo to the forehead. One should also apply a tilak- chāndlo of chandan to the chest and both arms. (53–54)

sanskrit_transliteration: Kevalam chandrakah strībhih kartavyas-tilakam na hi; Kumkuma dravyato bhāle smarantībhir Harim gurum.
gujarati_transliteration: Strioe Bhagwan tathā gurunu smaran kartā bhālne vishe keval kumkumno chāndlo karvo. Tilak na karvu. (55)
english_translation: While remembering Bhagwan and the guru, women should imprint only a kumkum chāndlo to their foreheads. They should not apply a tilak. (55)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Tatah pūjā’dhikārāya bhaktah satsangam āshritaha; Kuryād ātma-vichāram cha pratāpam chintayan Harehe.
Aksharam-aham ityevam bhaktyā prasanna chetasā; Purushottama dāso’smi mantram etam vadech-chhuchim.
Aksharabrahma rūpatvam svasyā’tmani vibhāvayet; Kuryāch-cha mānasīm pūjām shānta ekāgra chetasā.
gujarati_transliteration: Tyārbād satsangne āshrit bhakte pujānā adhikār māte Bhagwannā pratāpnu chintvan kartā kartā ātmavichār karvo. Prasanna chitte ane bhaktibhāv-purvak ‘Aksharam aham Purushottam-dāsosmi’ e pavitra mantranu uchchāran karvu. Potānā ātmāne vishe Aksharbrahmani vibhāvnā karvi ane shānt thai, ekāgra chitte mānsi pujā karvi. (56–58)
english_translation: Thereafter, to gain the privilege to perform puja, a devotee who has taken the refuge of satsang should meditate on their ātmā while contemplating upon the glory of Bhagwan. The sacred mantra ‘Aksharam-aham Purushottam-dāso’smi’9 should be recited with joy and devotion. One should identify one’s ātmā with Aksharbrahma and perform mānsi puja with a calm and focused mind. (56–58)

sanskrit_transliteration: Harir Brahma-gurush-chaiva bhavato moksha-dāyakau; Tayor eva hi kartavyam dhyānam mānasa-pūjanam.
gujarati_transliteration: Bhagwan ane brahmaswarup guru ja mokshadātā chhe. Temnā ja dhyān tathā mānsi pujā karvā. (59)
english_translation: Only Bhagwan and the Brahmaswarup guru can bestow moksha. Therefore, one should only meditate upon them and perform their mānsi puja. (59)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sthāpayech-chitra-mūrtīsh-cha shuchi vastropari tataha; Darshanam syād yathā samyak tathā hi bhakti-bhāvataha.
gujarati_transliteration: Tyārbād pavitra vastra upar chitra- pratimāonu sāri rite darshan thāy tem bhaktibhāv-purvak sthāpan karvu. (60)
english_translation: Thereafter, devoutly place the pictorial murtis on a clean cloth in a way that one can easily do their darshan. (60)

sanskrit_transliteration: Madhye tu sthāpayet tatra hyakshara-Purushottamau; Swāminam hi Guṇātītam Mahārājam cha tat param.
gujarati_transliteration: Temā madhyamā Akshar tathā Purushottamni murti padhrāvavi etle ke Gunatitanand Swami tathā temnāthi par evā Maharajne padhrāvavā. (61)
english_translation: In the centre, one should arrange the murtis of Akshar and Purushottam, that is, Gunatitanand Swami and the one who transcends him, [Shriji] Maharaj. (61)

sanskrit_transliteration: Pramukha-Swāmi paryantam pratyeka guru-mūrtayaha; Prasthāpyāh sevitānām cha pratyaksham mūrtayah svayam.
gujarati_transliteration: Tyārbād Pramukh Swami Maharaj paryant pratyek guruoni murtio padhrāvavi tathā pote pratyaksha sevyā hoy te guruoni murtio padhrāvavi. (62)
english_translation: One should then place the murtis of each guru up to Pramukh Swami Maharaj and the murtis of the gurus whom one has personally served. (62)

sanskrit_transliteration: Āhvāna-shlokam uchchārya Harim cha gurum āhvayet; Hastau baddhvā namaskāram kuryāddhi dāsa-bhāvataha.
gujarati_transliteration: Tyārbād āhvān shlok boline Maharaj tathā guruonu āhvān karvu. Be hāth jodi dāsbhāve namaskār karvā. (63)
english_translation: Thereafter, one should invite [Shriji] Maharaj and the gurus by reciting the Ahvan Mantra.10 One should bow with folded hands and with dāsbhāv. (63)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Uttishṭha Sahajānanda Shrī-Hare Purushottama; Guṇātītā’kshara Brahmann- uttishṭha krupayā guro.
Āgamyatām hi pūjārtham āgamyatām mad-ātmataha; Sānnidhyād darshanād divyāt saubhāgyam vardhate mama.
gujarati_transliteration: Ahvan Mantra ā pramāne chhe: Uttishtha Sahajānanda Shri-Hare Purushottama; Gunātitā’kshara brahmann- uttishtha krupayā guro. Āgamyatām hi pujārtham āgamyatām mad-ātmataha; Sānnidhyād darshanād divyāt saubhāgyam vardhate mama. (64–65)
english_translation: The Ahvan Mantra is as follows: Uttishtha Sahajānanda Shri-Hare Purushottama; Gunātitā’kshara brahmann- uttishtha krupayā guro. Āgamyatām hi pujārtham āgamyatām mad-ātmataha; Sānnidhyād darshanād divyāt saubhāgyam vardhate mama.11 (64–65)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Mālām āvartayed mantram Swāminārāyaṇam japan; Mahimnā darshanam kurvan mūrtīnām sthira-chetasā.
Eka-pādotthito bhūtvā mālām āvartayet tataha; Tapasa ūrdhva-hastah san kurvāṇo mūrti-darshanam.
gujarati_transliteration: Tyārbād sthir chitte tathā mahimā sāthe murtionā darshan kartā kartā Swaminarayan mantrano jāp kartā mālā feravavi. Tyārbād ek page ubhā rahi, hāth unchā rākhi murtionā darshan kartā tapni mālā feravavi. (66–67)
english_translation: Thereafter, with mahimā and a steady mind, one should perform mālā while chanting the Swaminarayan mantra and having darshan of the murtis. After- wards, while continuing to do darshan of the murtis, one should stand on one leg with arms raised and perform tapni mālā. (66–67)

sanskrit_transliteration: Tatah sanchintayan kuryād Akshara-Purushottamam; Vyāpakam sarva kendram cha pratimānām pradakshiṇāhā.
gujarati_transliteration: Tyārbād sarvanā kendra samān ane vyāpak evā Akshar-Purushottam Maharajne sambhā rtā pratimāoni pradakshinā karvi. (68)
english_translation: One should then perform pradakshinās of the murtis while contemplating upon Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj, who is pervasive and the focus of all. (68)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sāshṭāngā daṇḍavat kāryāh praṇāmāh purushais-tataha; Nārībhis-tūpavishyaiva panchāngā dāsa-bhāvataha.
gujarati_transliteration: Tyārbād dāsbhāve purushoe sāshtāng dandvat pranām karvā ane strioe besine panchāng pranām karvā. (69)
english_translation: Thereafter, with dāsbhāv, males should perform sāshtāng dandvat pranāms and females should sit and offer panchāng pranāms. (69)

sanskrit_transliteration: Praṇāmo daṇḍavach-chaikah kshamā-yāchana-pūrvakam; Bhakta-droha-nivārārtham kāryo’dhiko hi pratyaham.
gujarati_transliteration: Koi bhaktano droh thayo hoy tenā nivāranne arthe kshamāyāchnā-purvak pratidin ek dandvat pranām adhik karvo. (70)
english_translation: One should perform an additional dandvat pranām every day to seek forgiveness for hurting or harbouring ill- will towards another devotee. (70)

sanskrit_transliteration: Divya-bhāvena bhaktyā cha tad-anu prārthayej-japan; Swāminārāyaṇam mantram shubha-sankalpa-pūrtaye.
gujarati_transliteration: Tyārbād Swaminarayan mantrano jap kartā shubh sankalponi purti māte divyabhāv ane bhaktie sahit prārthanā (dhun) karvi. (71)
english_translation: Then, to fulfil one’s noble wishes, one should pray with divyabhāv and devotion while chanting the Swaminarayan mantra (dhun). (71)

sanskrit_transliteration: Bhaktitah pūjayitvaivam Akshara-Purushottamam; Punar-āgama-mantreṇa prasthāpayen-nijātmani.
gujarati_transliteration: Ā rite bhaktibhāve pujā karine Punaragaman Mantrathi Akshar-Purushottam Maharajne potānā ātmāne vishe padhrāvavā. (72)
english_translation: After devoutly performing puja in this way, one should re-install Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj within one’s ātmā by reciting the Punaragaman Mantra.12 (72)

sanskrit_transliteration: Bhaktyaiva divya-bhāvena pūjā te samanushṭhitā; Gachchhā’tha tvam mad-ātmānam Akshara-Purushottama.
gujarati_transliteration: Punaragaman Mantra ā pramāne chhe: Bhaktyaiva divya-bhāvena pujā te sam-anushthitā, Gachchhā’tha tvam mad-ātmānam Akshara-Purushottama. (73)
english_translation: The Punaragaman Mantra is as follows: Bhaktyaiva divya-bhāvena pujā te sam-anushthitā, Gachchhā’tha tvam mad-ātmānam Akshara-Purushottama.13 (73)

sanskrit_transliteration: Tatah satsanga-dārḍhyāya shāstram paṭhyam cha pratyaham; Ādeshāsh-chopadeshāsh-cha yatra santi Harer guroho.
gujarati_transliteration: Tyārbād satsangni dradhtā māte jemā Shri Hari tathā gurunā updesho ane ādesho samāyā hoy tevā shāstranu roj vānchan karvu. (74)
english_translation: To strengthen one’s satsang, one should then daily read shastras that encompass the teachings and instructions of Shri Hari and the gurus. (74)

sanskrit_transliteration: Tad-anu praṇamed bhaktān ādarān-namra-bhāvataha; Evam pūjām samāpyaiva kuryāt sva-vyāvahārikam.
gujarati_transliteration: Tyārbād ādar ane namrabhāve bhaktone pranām karvā. Ā rite pujā karine pachhi ja potānā vyavahārnu kārya karvu. (75)
english_translation: Thereafter, one should bow to devotees with reverence and humility. Only after performing puja in this way should one engage in one’s daily activities. (75)

sanskrit_transliteration: Bhojyam naiva na peyam vā vinā pūjām jalādikam; Pravāsa-gamane chā’pi pūjām naiva pari-tyajet.
gujarati_transliteration: Pujā karyā vinā jamvu nahi ne pāni vagere pan na pivu. Pravāse gayā hoie to pan pujāno tyāg na karvo. (76)
english_translation: One should not eat food or even drink water or other liquids without performing puja. One should not give up one’s puja even during outings. (76)

sanskrit_transliteration: Vārdhakyena cha rogādyair anyā’paddhetunā tathā; Pūjārtham asamarthash-chet tadā’nyaih kārayet sa tām.
gujarati_transliteration: Vruddhāvasthā, rogādi tathā anya āpattine lidhe pote pujā karvā asamartha hoy tene anya pāse te pujā karāvavi. (77)
english_translation: If one is incapable of doing puja because of old age, illness or other difficulties, one should have one’s puja performed by another. (77)

sanskrit_transliteration: Svīyapūjā svatantrā tu sarvai rakshyā gruhe pruthak; Janmano divasād eva pūjā grāhyā sva-santatehe.
gujarati_transliteration: Gharmā pratyek satsangie potāni svatantra pujā rākhvi. Vali putra ke putrino janma thāy te divasthi ja santān māte pujā lai levi. (78)
english_translation: Every satsangi in a household should keep their own separate puja. Moreover, one should acquire a puja for a child on the same day that he or she is born. (78)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Bhakti-prārthana-satsanga- hetunā prati-vāsaram; Sundaram mandiram sthāpyam sarvaih satsangibhir gruhe.
Prasthāpyau vidhivat tasminn- Akshara-Purushottamau; Guravash-cha Guṇātītā bhaktyā paramparā-gatāhā.
gujarati_transliteration: Nitya pratye bhakti, prārthanā tathā satsang māte sarve satsangioe gharmā sundar mandir sthāpvu. Temā bhaktibhāve vidhivat Akshar-Purushottam tathā paramparāmā āvel Gunatit guruo padhrāvavā. (79–80)
english_translation: All satsangis should place a beautiful mandir within their homes where they can daily offer devotion, pray and practise satsang. Within the mandir, one should devoutly and ceremonially consecrate the murtis of Akshar-Purushottam and the Gunatit gurus of the tradition. (79–80)

sanskrit_transliteration: Prātah prati-dinam sāyam sarvaih satsangibhir janaihi; Ārārtikyam vidhātavyam sa-stuti gruha-mandire.
gujarati_transliteration: Sarve satsangi janoe prātah-kāle tathā sānje ghar-mandirmā pratidin ārti karvi ne sāthe stutinu gān karvu. (81)
english_translation: Every morning and evening, all satsangis should perform the ārti and sing the stuti before the ghar mandir. (81)

sanskrit_transliteration: Uchchaih svarair Jaya Swāmi- nārāyaṇeti bhaktitaha; Sa-tāli-vādanam geyam sthireṇa chetasā tadā.
gujarati_transliteration: Ārti samaye chittne sthir kari bhaktie sahit, tāli vagādtā ane uchch svare ‘Jay Swaminarayan Jay Akshar-Purushottam…’ em ārtinu gān karvu. (82)
english_translation: While performing the ārti, one should devoutly sing aloud the ārti ‘Jay Swaminarayan, Jay Akshar-Purushottam…’ with a steady mind and while clapping. (82)

sanskrit_transliteration: Yaiva rasavatī pakvā mandire tām nivedayet; Uchchārya prārthanam bhaktyā tatah prasāditam jamet.
gujarati_transliteration: Je rasoi banāvi hoy te mandirmā dharāvavi ane prasādibhut thayel bhojan bhaktibhāv- purvak prārthanā boline pachhi jamvu. (83)
english_translation: Offer whatever food has been prepared [to the murtis] in the ghar mandir and after devoutly reciting prayers, eat the sanctified meal. (83)

sanskrit_transliteration: Haraye’narpya na grāhyam anna-fala-jalādikam; Shuddhau shankitam annādi nā’dyānneshe nivedayet.
gujarati_transliteration: Bhagwanne arpan karyā vagar anna, fal ke jalādi grahan na karvu. Jeni shuddhine vishe shankā hoy tevā annādi Bhagwanne na dharāvavā ane na jamvā. (84)
english_translation: One should not consume foods, fruits, water and other items without first offering them to Bhagwan. Foods and other items that may be impure should not be offered to Bhagwan nor should they be eaten. (84)

sanskrit_transliteration: Kīrtanam vā japam kuryāt smrutyādi vā yathā-ruchi; Gruha-mandiram āsthāya bhāvatah sthira-chetasā.
gujarati_transliteration: Ghar-mandirmā besine bhāve karine sthir chitte kirtan, jap ke smruti vagere potāni ruchi anusār karvu. (85)
english_translation: While sitting in front of the ghar mandir, one should, with devout feelings and concentration, sing kirtans, chant and engage in smruti or other acts of devotion according to one’s preferences. (85)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sambhūya pratyaham kāryā gruha-sabhā gruhasthitaihi; Kartavyam bhajanam goshṭhih shāstra-pāṭhādi tatra cha.
gujarati_transliteration: Gharnā sabhyoe bhegā thai roj ghar sabhā karvi ane temā bhajan, goshthi tathā shāstronu vānchan ityādi karvu. (86)
english_translation: Family members should gather daily for ghar sabhā and engage in bhajan, discussions, scriptural reading and other devotional activities. (86)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Shuddhopāsana-bhaktim hi poshayitum cha rakshitum; Bhaktim mandira-nirmāṇa- rūpām prāvartayaddharihi.
Tathaivā’gnāpayām āsa sevārtham Hariṇā saha; Tasya chottama-bhaktasya tasyevaivā’ksharasya cha.
gujarati_transliteration: Shri Harie shuddha upāsanā-bhaktinā poshan ane rakshan māte mandir nirmānrup bhaktinu pravartan karyu. Ane Bhagwanni jemaj temnā uttam bhakta evā Aksharbrahmani Bhagwanni sāthe sevā karvā māte āgnā kari. (87–88)
english_translation: Shri Hari inspired the creation of mandirs as a form of devotion to foster and protect pure upāsanā and bhakti. He instructed that, along with Bhagwan, one should also serve his su- preme devotee, Aksharbrahma, in the very same manner that one serves Bhagwan. (87–88)

sanskrit_transliteration: Vartata uttamo bhakto Brahma Bhagavato’ksharam; Nityam māyā-param nityam Hari-sevāratam yataha.
gujarati_transliteration: Aksharbrahma Bhagwannā uttam bhakta chhe, kāran ke teo nitya māyāpar chhe ane nitya Bhagwanni sevāmā ramamān hoy chhe. (89)
english_translation: Aksharbrahma is Bhagwan’s supreme devotee because he eternally transcends māyā and is forever engrossed in Bhagwan’s service. (89)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Mandirāṇām hi nirmāṇam tad-āgnām-anusrutya cha; Divyānām kriyate bhaktyā sarva-kalyāṇa-hetunā.
Purushottama-mūrtyā tad- madhya-khaṇḍe yathā-vidhi; Sahitam sthāpyate mūrtir Aksharasyā’pi Brahmaṇaha.
gujarati_transliteration: Te āgnāne anusarine sarvanu kalyān thāy te hetuthi divya mandironu nirmān bhaktibhāvthi karvāmā āve chhe ane tenā madhya khandmā Purushottam Bhagwanni murtini sāthe Akshar brahmani murti pan vidhivat sthāpvāmā āve chhe. (90–91)
english_translation: To fulfil this ordinance and to grant moksha to all, divine mandirs are devoutly constructed and the murti of Aksharbrahma is also ceremoniously consecrated with Purushottam Bhagwan in the central shrines [of these mandirs]. (90–91)

sanskrit_transliteration: Evam eva gruhādyeshu kruteshu mandireshvapi; Madhye prasthāpyate nityam sā’ksharah Purushottamaha.
gujarati_transliteration: Ej rite ghar ādi sthalone vishe karel mandiromā pan madhyamā hammeshā Aksharbrahma sahit Purushottam Bhagwanne prasthāpit karvāmā āve chhe. (92)
english_translation: Similarly, Aksharbrahma and Purushottam Bhagwan are also always consecrated in the central shrines of mandirs in homes and other places. (92)

sanskrit_transliteration: Prātah sāyam yathā-kālam sarva-satsangibhir janaihi; Nikaṭam mandiram gamyam bhaktyā darshāya pratyaham.
gujarati_transliteration: Sarve satsangioe savāre, sānje athvā potānā anukul samaye pratidin bhaktie karine samipe āvel mandire darshane javu. (93)
english_translation: Daily, in the morning, evening or at another convenient time, all satsangis should devoutly go to a nearby mandir for darshan. (93)

sanskrit_transliteration: Yathā sva-dharma-rakshā syāt tathaiva vastra-dhāraṇam; Satsangi-nara-nārībhih karaṇīyam hi sarvadā.
gujarati_transliteration: Sarve satsangi nar-nārioe sadāy je rite potānā dharmani rakshā thāy te ja rite vastro dhārvā. (94)
english_translation: All satsangi men and women should always dress in a manner that safeguards their dharma. (94)

sanskrit_transliteration: Satsanga-draḍhatārtham hi sabhārtham antike sthitam; Gantavyam prati-saptāham mandiram vā’pi maṇḍalam.
gujarati_transliteration: Satsangni dradhtā māte dar athvādiye samip āvel mandirmā ke mandalmā sabhā bharvā javu. (95)
english_translation: To strengthen one’s satsang, one should attend the weekly assemblies held at a nearby mandir or centre. (95)

sanskrit_transliteration: Swāminārāyaṇah sākshād- Aksharādhipatir-Harihi; Paramātmā Parabrahma Bhagavān Purushottamaha.
gujarati_transliteration: Aksharādhipati Swaminarayan Bhagwan sākshāt Paramatma Parabrahma Purushottam Hari chhe. (96)
english_translation: Swaminarayan Bhagwan, the sovereign of Akshar, is the manifest form of Paramatma Parabrahma Purushottam Hari. (96)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sa ekah paramopāsya ishṭa-devo hi nah sadā; Tasyaiva sarvadā bhaktih kartavyā’nanya-bhāvataha.
gujarati_transliteration: E ekaj āpnā sadā param upāsya ishtadev chhe. Temni ja ananya bhāve sadā bhakti karvi. (97)
english_translation: He alone is forever our ishtadev worthy of supreme upāsanā. One should always offer singular devotion to him only. (97)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sākshād Brahmā’ksharam Swāmī Guṇātītah sanātanam; Tasya paramparā’dyā’pi Brahmā’ksharasya rājate.
gujarati_transliteration: Gunatitanand Swami sākshāt sanātan Aksharbrahma chhe. E Aksharbrahmani paramparā āje pan virājmān chhe. (98)
english_translation: Gunatitanand Swami is the manifest form of the eternal Aksharbrahma. This Aksharbrahma paramparā is manifest even today. (98)

sanskrit_transliteration: Guṇātīta-samārabdha- paramparā-pratishṭhitaha; Prakaṭā’kshara-brahmaikah sampradāye’sti no guruhu.
gujarati_transliteration: Sampradaymā Gunatitanand Swamithi ārambhāyel guru paramparāmā āvel pragat Aksharbrahma e ekaj āpnā guru chhe. (99)
english_translation: In the Sampradaya’s tradition of gurus that began with Gunatitanand Swami, only the present form of Aksharbrahma is our guru. (99)

sanskrit_transliteration: Eka eveshṭa-devo nah eka eva gurus-tathā; Ekash-chaivā’pi siddhānta evam nah ekatā sadā.
gujarati_transliteration: Āpnā ishtadev ekaj chhe, guru ekaj chhe ane siddhānt pan ekaj chhe em āpni sadā ektā chhe. (100)
english_translation: Our ishtadev is the same, our guru is the same and our siddhānt is also the same – thus, we are always united. (100)

sanskrit_transliteration: Siddhāntam suvijānīyād Akshara-Purushottamam; Brahmavidyātmakam divyam vaidikam cha sanātanam.
gujarati_transliteration: Brahmavidyā-rup, vaidik ane sanātan evā divya Akshar-Purushottam siddhāntne jānvo. (101)
english_translation: One should know [and realize] the divine Akshar-Purushottam siddhānt, which is Vedic, eternal and the form of brahmavidyā. (101)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Jīvas-tatheshvarash-chaiva māyā brahmā’ksharam tathā; Parabrahmeti tattvāni bhinnāni pancha sarvadā.
Nityān yatha cha satyāni vigneyāni mumukshubhihi; Swāminārāyaṇenaivam siddhāntitam svayam sfuṭam.
gujarati_transliteration: Jiva, ishwar, māyā, Aksharbrahma tathā Parabrahma e pānch tattvo sadāy bhinna chhe, nitya chhe, satya chhe em mumukshuoe jānvu – em svayam Swaminarayan Bhagwane spashta siddhānt karyo chhe. (102–103)
english_translation: Mumukshus should realize that the five enti- ties – jiva, ishwar, māyā, Aksharbrahma and Parabrahma – are forever distinct, eternal and true Swaminarayan Bhagwan himself established this clear siddhānt. (102–103)

sanskrit_transliteration: Teshu māyā-parau nityam Akshara-Purushottamau; Jīvānām-īshvarāṇām cha muktis-tad-yogato bhavet.
gujarati_transliteration: Temā Akshar ane Purushottam e be sadāy māyāthi par chhe ane jivo tathā ishwaroni mukti temnā yogthi thāy chhe. (104)
english_translation: Among these entities, Akshar and Purushottam are the two who are eternally beyond māyā. Jivas and ishwars attain moksha by associating with them. (104)

sanskrit_transliteration: Paramātmā Parabrahma param Brahmā’ksharāt sadā; Brahmā’pi sevate tam cha dāsa-bhāvena sarvadā.
gujarati_transliteration: Paramatma Parabrahma sadā Akshar- brahmathi par chhe ane Aksharbrahma pan te Paramatmani nitya dāsbhāve sevā kare chhe. (105)
english_translation: Paramatma Parabrahma is forever superior to Aksharbrahma. Furthermore, even Aksharbrahma eternally serves Paramatma with dāsbhāv. (105)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sarva-kartā cha sākārah sarvopari sadā Harihi; Mumukshūṇām vimokshāya prakaṭo vartate sadā.
gujarati_transliteration: Bhagwan sadāy sarva-kartā, sākār, sarvopari chhe ane mumukshuoni mukti māte hammeshā pragat rahe chhe. (106)
english_translation: Bhagwan is eternally the all-doer, with form, and supreme; he always remains manifest for the moksha of mumukshus. (106)

sanskrit_transliteration: Brahmā’kshara-guru-dvārā Bhagavān prakaṭah sadā; Sahitah sakalaishvaryaih paramā’nandam arpayan.
gujarati_transliteration: Aksharbrahma-swarup guru dvārā Bhagwan potānā sakal aishvaryo sahit, paramānand arptā thakā sadāy pragat rahe chhe. (107)
english_translation: Through the Aksharbrahma guru, Bhagwan always remains present with all of his divinity and bestows utmost bliss. (107)

sanskrit_transliteration: Prītih kāryā’tma-buddhish-cha Brahmā’kshare gurau draḍhā; Pratyaksha-Bhagavad-bhāvāt sevyo dhyeyah sa bhaktitaha.
gujarati_transliteration: Aksharbrahma gurune vishe dradh priti ane ātmabuddhi karvi. Temne vishe pratyaksha Bhagwanno bhāv lāvine bhaktie karine temni sevā tathā dhyān karvā. (108)
english_translation: One should foster intense love and ātmabuddhi for the Aksharbrahma guru. Believing the guru as the manifest form of Bhagwan, one should serve him and meditate upon him with devotion. (108)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Swāminārāyaṇo mantro divyash-chā’laukikah shubhaha; Japyo’yam sakalair bhaktair datto’yam Hariṇā svayam.
Aksharam Brahma vigneyam mantre Swāmīti shabdataha; Nārāyaṇeti shabdena tat-parah Purushottamaha.
gujarati_transliteration: Swaminarayan mantra divya, alaukik ane shubh mantra chhe. Swayam Shri Harie ā mantra āpyo chhe. Sarva bhaktoe teno jap karvo. Ā mantramā ‘Swami’ shabdathi Aksharbrahmane samajvā ane ‘Narayan’ shabdathi te Aksharbrahmathi par evā Purushottamne samajvā. (109–110)
english_translation: The ‘Swaminarayan’ mantra is divine, beyond this world and auspicious. Shri Hari himself bestowed this mantra. All devotees should chant it. In this mantra, understand that ‘Swami’ refers to Aksharbrahma, and ‘Narayan’ refers to Purushottam, who is superior to Aksharbrahma. (109–110)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Swāminārāyaṇeneha siddhānto’yam prabodhitaha; Gurubhish-cha Guṇātītair digante’yam pravartitaha.
Yagnapurushadāsena sthāpito mūrti-mattayā; Guru-charitra-grantheshu punar ayam draḍhāyitaha.
Pramukha-guruṇā yo’yam svīyā’ksharaih sthirī-krutaha; Sākshād guroh prasangena labhyate’yam hi jīvane.
Ayam eva sa siddhānto mukti-pradah sanātanaha; Uchyate darshanam divyam Akshara-Purushottamam.
gujarati_transliteration: Ā siddhānt Bhagwan Swaminarayane ā lokmā prabodhyo. Gunatit guruoe tenu digantmā pravartan karyu. Shastriji Maharaje tene murtimān karyo. Guruonā jivan-charitra-granthomā teni punah dradhtā karāvavāmā āvi. Ā siddhāntne guruhari Pramukh Swami Maharaje potānā hastāksharthi lakhi sthir karyo. Sākshāt guruharinā prasangthi ā siddhānt jivanmā prāpta kari shakāy chhe. Te ā sanātan muktiprad siddhāntne ja divya ‘Akshar-Purushottam Darshan’ kahevāmā āve chhe. (111–114)
english_translation: Bhagwan Swaminarayan revealed this siddhānt in this world. The Gunatit gurus spread it throughout the world. Shastriji Maharaj enshrined it in the form of murtis. It was reaffirmed in the jivan charitra texts of the gurus. This siddhānt was securely established by guruhari Pramukh Swami Maharaj in his own handwriting. This siddhānt may be imbibed in one’s life through the association of the manifest guruhari. It is this eternal and moksha- bestowing siddhānt that is known as the divine ‘Akshar-Purushottam Darshan’. (111–114)

sanskrit_transliteration: Siddhāntam paramam divyam etādrusham vichintayan; Satsangam nishṭhayā kuryād ānandotsāha-pūrvakam.
gujarati_transliteration: Āvā param divya siddhāntnu chintvan kartā kartā nishthāthi ane ānand-utsāh- purvak satsang karvo. (115)
english_translation: While reflecting on such a supremely divine siddhānt, one should engage in satsang with conviction, joy and enthusiasm. (115)

sanskrit_transliteration: Nijā’tmānam brahmarūpam deha-traya-vilakshaṇam; Vibhāvyopāsanam kāryam sadaiva Parabrahmaṇaha.
gujarati_transliteration: Tran dehthi vilakshan evā potānā ātmāne vishe brahmarupni vibhāvnā kari sadaiva Parabrahmani upāsanā karvi. (116)
english_translation: Identify one’s ātmā, which is distinct from the three bodies, as brahmarup and always offer upāsanā to Parabrahma. (116)

sanskrit_transliteration: Aksharādhipater bhaktim sa-dharmām ācharet sadā; Dharmeṇa rahitām naiva bhaktim kuryāt kadāchana.
gujarati_transliteration: Aksharādhipati Paramatmani bhakti sadā dharme sahit karvi. Kyārey dharme rahit bhakti na karvi. (117)
english_translation: One should offer devotion to Paramatma, the sovereign of Akshar, while always upholding dharma. One should never perform bhakti without dharma. (117)

sanskrit_transliteration: Bhaktim vā gnānam ālambya naivā’dharmam charej-janaha; Api parva-vishesham vā’- lambya nā’dharmam ācharet.
gujarati_transliteration: Bhaktinu ke jnānnu ālamban laine ke koi parvanu ālamban laine pan manushyae adharmanu ācharan na karvu. (118)
english_translation: One should not behave immorally even under the pretext of devotion, wisdom or festivals. (118)

sanskrit_transliteration: Bhangā-surādi-pānam vā dyūtādi-krīḍanam tathā; Gāli-dānādikam naiva parvasvapi samācharet.
gujarati_transliteration: Parvane vishe pan bhāng, dāru vagerenu pān karvu, jugār vagere ramvu, gālo bolvi ityādi na karvu. (119)
english_translation: Even during festivities, one should abstain from bhang, alcohol and other such substances, as well as gambling, swearing and other such activities. (119)

sanskrit_transliteration: Parasmād Brahmaṇo’nyasmin- naksharād Brahmaṇas-tathā; Prītyabhāvo hi vairāgyam angam bhakteh sahāyakam.
gujarati_transliteration: Parabrahma tathā Aksharbrahma sivāy anyatra priti na hovi te vairāgya chhe. Te bhaktinu sahāyak ang chhe. (120)
english_translation: Vairāgya is to not have love for anything or anyone other than Parabrahma and Aksharbrahma. It serves to support bhakti. (120)

sanskrit_transliteration: Nindā-lajjā-bhayā’padbhyah satsangam na pari-tyajet; Swāminārāyaṇam Devam tad-bhaktim karhichid gurum.
gujarati_transliteration: Nindā, lajjā, bhay ke mushkelione lidhe kyārey satsang, Swaminarayan Bhagwan, temni bhakti ane guruno tyāg na karvo. (121)
english_translation: When faced with criticism, shame, fear or difficulty, one should never abandon satsang, Swaminarayan Bhagwan, devotion towards him, or the guru. (121)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sevā Haresh-cha bhaktānām kartavyā shuddha-bhāvataha; Mahad-bhāgyam mamāstīti matvā sva-moksha-hetunā.
gujarati_transliteration: Bhagwan ane bhaktoni sevā shuddhabhāve, mārā motā bhāgya chhe em mānine potānā moksha māte karvi. (122)
english_translation: One should serve Bhagwan and his devotees with pure intentions, believing it to be one’s great fortune and with the goal of attaining one’s moksha. (122)

sanskrit_transliteration: Neyo na vyarthatām kālah satsangam bhajanam vinā; Ālasyam cha pramādādi pari-tyājyam hi sarvadā.
gujarati_transliteration: Satsang ane bhajan vinā vyartha kāl nirgamvo nahi. Ālas tathā pramād vagereno hammeshā parityāg karvo. (123)
english_translation: One should not let time pass wastefully without satsang or devotion. One should always give up laziness and negligence. (123)

sanskrit_transliteration: Kuryāddhi bhajanam kurvan kriyā āgnā’nusārataha; Kriyā-bandhah kriyā-bhārah kriyāmānas-tato nahi.
gujarati_transliteration: Bhajan kartā kartā kriyā karvi. Āgnā anusāre karvi. Ām karvāthi kriyānu bandhan na thāy, kriyāno bhār na lāge ane kriyānu mān na āve. (124)
english_translation: One should perform tasks while engaging in devotion and according to āgnā. By doing so, one will not become attached to one’s actions, be burdened by them or develop ego because of them. (124)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sevayā kathayā smrutyā dhyānena paṭhanādibhihi; Sufalam samayam kuryād Bhagavat-kīrtanādibhihi.
gujarati_transliteration: Sevā, kathā, smaran, dhyān, pathanādi tathā bhagvat-kirtan vagerethi samayne sufal karvo. (125)
english_translation: One should fruitfully use time by performing sevā, listening to discourses, doing smruti, meditating, studying, singing kirtans of Bhagwan and engaging in other such activities. (125)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sva-dur-guṇān apā-kartum sam-prāptum sad-guṇāns-tathā; Satsangā’shrayaṇam kāryam svasya parama-muktaye.
gujarati_transliteration: Satsangno āshro potānā durgunone tālvā, sadgunone prāpta karvā ane potānā param kalyān māte karvo. (126)
english_translation: One should take the refuge of satsang to rid oneself of flaws, acquire virtues and attain ultimate moksha. (126)

sanskrit_transliteration: Prasannatām samāvāptum Swāminārāyaṇa-Prabhoho; Guṇātīta-gurūṇām cha satsangam āshrayet sadā.
gujarati_transliteration: Swaminarayan Bhagwan tathā Gunatit guruoni prasannatā prāpta karvā sadā satsangno āshro karvo. (127)
english_translation: One should forever take the refuge of satsang to attain the pleasure of Swaminarayan Bhagwan and the Gunatit gurus. (127)

sanskrit_transliteration: Aho ihaiva nah prāptāv- Akshara-Purushottamau; Tat-prāpti-gauravān-nityam satsang-ānandam āpnuyāt.
gujarati_transliteration: Aho! Āpanne Akshar ane Purushottam banne ahi ja malyā chhe. Temni prāptinā kefthi satsangnā ānandne sadāy mānvo. (128)
english_translation: O! We have attained both Akshar and Purushottam here [in this life]. With the joy of having attained them, one should always relish the bliss of satsang. (128)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Sevā-bhakti-kathā-dhyāna- tapo-yātrādi sādhanam; Mānato dambhato naiva kāryam naivershyayā tathā.
Spardhayā dveshato naiva na laukika-falechchhayā; Shraddhayā shuddha-bhāvena kāryam prasannatā-dhiyā.
gujarati_transliteration: Sevā, bhakti, kathā, dhyān, tap tathā yātrā ityādi sādhan karie te māne karine, dambhe karine, irshāe karine, spardhāe karine, dveshe karine ke pachhi laukik falni ichchhāthi na ja karvu. Parantu shraddhāe sahit, shuddhabhāvthi ane Bhagwanne rāji karvāni bhāvnāthi karvu. (129–130)
english_translation: One should never perform sevā, devotion, discourses, meditation, austerities, pilgrimages and other endeavours out of vanity, pretence, jealousy, competition, enmity or for the attainment of worldly fruits. However, they should be performed with faith, pure intentions and the wish to please Bhagwan. (129–130)

sanskrit_transliteration: Drashyo na mānusho bhāvo Bhagavati tathā gurau; Māyā-parau yato divyāv- Akshara-Purushottamau.
gujarati_transliteration: Bhagwan tathā gurune vishe manushyabhāv na jovo. Kāran ke Akshar ane Purushottam banne māyāthi par chhe, divya chhe. (131)
english_translation: One should not perceive human traits in Bhagwan or the guru, since both Akshar and Purushottam are beyond māyā and divine. (131)

sanskrit_transliteration: Vishvāsah su-draḍhī-kāryo Bhagavati tathā gurau; Nirbalatvam pari-tyājyam dhāryam dhairyam arer balam.
gujarati_transliteration: Bhagwan tathā gurune vishe vishvās dradh karvo, nirbaltāno tyāg karvo, dhiraj rākhvi tathā Bhagwannu bal rākhvu. (132)
english_translation: One should develop firm faith in Bhagwan and the guru, renounce feebleness, have patience and derive strength from Bhagwan. (132)

sanskrit_transliteration: Kāryam līlā-charitrāṇām Swāminārāyaṇa-Prabhoho; Shravaṇam kathanam pāṭho mananam nidi-dhyāsanam.
gujarati_transliteration: Swaminarayan Bhagwannā lilā-charitronu shravan, kathan, vānchan, manan tathā nididhyāsan karvu. (133)
english_translation: One should listen to, recite, read, reflect upon and repeatedly recall the incidents of Swaminarayan Bhagwan. (133)

sanskrit_transliteration: Prasangah parayā prītyā Brahmā’kshara-guroh sadā; Kartavyo divya-bhāvena pratyakshasya mumukshubhihi.
gujarati_transliteration: Mumukshuoe pratyaksha Aksharbrahma guruno prasang sadā param priti ane divyabhāvthi karvo. (134)
english_translation: Mumukshus should always associate with the manifest Aksharbrahma guru with supreme love and divyabhāv. (134)

sanskrit_transliteration: Brahmā’kshare gurau prītir draḍhaivā’sti hi sādhanam; Brahma-sthiteh pari-prāpteh sākshāt-kārasya cha Prabhoho.
gujarati_transliteration: Aksharbrahma-swarup gurune vishe dradh priti e ja brāhmi sthiti tathā Bhagwannā sākshātkārne pāmvānu sādhan chhe. (135)
english_translation: Intense affection for the Aksharbrahma guru is the only means to attaining the brāhmic state and realizing Bhagwan. (135)

sanskrit_transliteration: Brahma-guṇa-samāvāptyai Parabrahmā’nubhūtaye; Brahma-guroh prasangānām kartavyam mananam sadā.
gujarati_transliteration: Aksharbrahma gurunā guno ātmasāt karvā māte tathā Parabrahmani anubhuti māte Aksharbrahma gurunā prasangonu sadāy manan karvu. (136)
english_translation: To imbibe the virtues of the Aksharbrahma guru and to experience Parabrahma, one should always reflect on the incidents of the Aksharbrahma guru. (136)

sanskrit_transliteration: Manasā karmaṇā vāchā sevyo Guruharih sadā; Kartavyā tatra pratyaksha- Nārāyaṇa-svarūpa-dhīhi.
gujarati_transliteration: Man-karma-vachane guruharinu sadā sevan karvu ane temne vishe pratyaksha Narayan-swarupni bhāvnā karvi. (137)
english_translation: One should associate with one’s guruhari through thought, word and deed and should realize him as ‘Narayanswarup’ – the manifest form of Narayan [Parabrahma]. (137)

sanskrit_transliteration: Shruṇuyān-na vaden-nā’pi vārtām hīnām balena cha; Bala-pūrṇām sadā kuryād vārtām satsangam āsthitaha.
gujarati_transliteration: Satsangie kyārey bal-rahit vāt sāmbhalvi nahi ane karvi pan nahi. Hammeshā bal bhareli vāto karvi. (138)
english_translation: A satsangi should never listen to or speak discouraging words. One should always speak encouraging words. (138)

sanskrit_transliteration: Vārtā kāryā mahimno hi Brahma-Parama-brahmaṇoho; Tat-sambandha-vatām chā’pi sa-sneham ādarāt sadā.
gujarati_transliteration: Preme karine tathā ādar thaki Brahma ane Parabrahmanā mahimāni tathā temnā sambandh-vālānā mahimāni vāto nirantar karvi. (139)
english_translation: With affection and reverence, one should continuously speak of the glory of Brahma and Parabrahma and the greatness of those who are associated with them. (139)

sanskrit_transliteration: Satsangishu suhrad-bhāvo divya-bhāvas-tathaiva cha; Aksharabrahma-bhāvash-cha vidhātavyo mumukshuṇā.
gujarati_transliteration: Mumukshue satsangione vishe suhradbhāv, divyabhāv tathā brahmabhāv rākhvā. (140)
english_translation: Mumukshus should keep suhradbhāv, divya bhāv and brahmabhāv towards satsangis. (140)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Paramātma-Parabrahma- Swāminārāyaṇa-Prabhoho; Brahmā’kshara-svarūpasya Guṇātīta-guros-tathā.
Tad-arpitasya divyasya siddhāntasya cha sarvadā; Bhaktānām tach-chhritānām cha paksho grāhyo vivekataha.
gujarati_transliteration: Paramatma Parabrahma Swaminarayan Bhagwan, Aksharbrahma-swarup Gunatit guru, temne āpel divya siddhānt tathā temnā āshrit bhaktono viveke karine sadāy paksha rakhvo. (141–142)
english_translation: With discretion, one should always keep the paksha of Paramatma Parabrahma Swaminarayan Bhagwan, the Akshar brahma Gunatit guru, the divine siddhānt they have imparted and the devotees who have sought their refuge. (141–142)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Āgnām Bhagavato nityam Brahma-gurosh-cha pālayet; Gnātvā tad-anuvruttim cha tām evā’nusared draḍham.
Tad-āgnām pālayet sadya ālasyādi vihāya cha; Sānandotsāha-māhātmyam tat-prasāda-dhiyā sadā.
gujarati_transliteration: Bhagwan ane brahmaswarup guruni āgnānu sadāy pālan karvu. Temni anuvrutti jānine tene dradhpane anusarvu. Temni āgnā ālas vagere mukine pālvi, tarat pālvi; sadā ānand, utsāh ane mahimā sāthe temne rāji karvānā bhāvthi pālvi. (143–144)
english_translation: One should always obey the commands of Bhagwan and the Brahmaswarup guru. One should realize their inner wishes and firmly abide by them. Their instructions should be followed without laziness, immediately, and always with joy, enthusiasm, mahimā and an eagerness to please them. (143–144)

sanskrit_transliteration: Antar-drashṭish-cha kartavyā pratyaham sthira-chetasā; Kim kartum āgato’smīha kim kurve’ham iheti cha.
gujarati_transliteration: Pratidin sthir chitte antardrashti karvi ke hu ā lokmā shu karvā avyo chhu? Ane shu kari rahyo chhu? (145)
english_translation: With a composed mind, one should introspect every day: “What have I come to accomplish in this world and what am I doing?” (145)

sanskrit_transliteration: Samprāpyā’kshara-rūpatvam bhajeyam Purushottamam; Pratyaham chintayed evam svīya-lakshyam atandritaha.
gujarati_transliteration: ‘Aksharrup thaine hu Purushottamni bhakti karu’ em potānā lakshyanu chintan ālas rākhyā vagar roj karvu. (146)
english_translation: “Having attained oneness with Akshar, I offer devotion to Purushottam.” In this manner, one should reflect on one’s goal each day without laziness. (146)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Kartā’yam sarva-hartā’yam sarvopari niyāmakaha; Pratyaksham iha labdho me Swāminārāyaṇo Harihi.
Ata evā’smi dhanyo’ham parama-bhāgyavān aham; Krutārthash-chaiva nihshanko nishchinto’smi sadā sukhī.
gujarati_transliteration: Ā Swaminarayan Bhagwan sarva-kartā- hartā chhe, sarvopari chhe, niyāmak chhe. Teo mane ahi pratyaksha malyā chhe. Āthi ja hu dhanya chhu, param bhāgyashāli chhu, krutārth chhu, nihshank chhu, nishchint chhu ane sadā sukhi chhu. (147–148)
english_translation: Swaminarayan Bhagwan is the all-doer,14 supreme entity and controller. I have his association here in person. For this very reason, I am joyous, greatly fortunate, fulfilled, without doubts and worries, and forever blissful. (147–148)

sanskrit_transliteration: Evam prāpter mahimnash-cha pratyaham pari-chintanam; Prabhoh prasannatāyāsh-cha kāryam sthireṇa chetasā.
gujarati_transliteration: Ā rite Paramatmani divya prāptinu, mahimānu tathā temni prasannatānu chintan darroj sthir chitte karvu. (149)
english_translation: In this way, with a composed mind, one should reflect daily on one’s divine attainment of Paramatma, his greatness and [attaining] his pleasure. (149)

sanskrit_transliteration: Deha-traya-tryavasthāto gnātvā bhedam guṇa-trayāt; Svātmano Brahmaṇaikatvam prati-dinam vibhāvayet.
gujarati_transliteration: Potānā ātmāne tran deh, tran avasthā tathā tran gunthi judo samji teni Aksharbrahma sāthe ektāni vibhāvnā pratidin karvi. (150)
english_translation: Realizing one’s ātmā to be distinct from the three bodies,15 the three states,16 and the three qualities,17every day one should believe oneself as being one with Aksharbrahma. (150)

sanskrit_transliteration: Pratyaham anusandheyā jagato nāsha-shīlatā; Svātmano nityatā chintyā sach-chid-ānanda-rūpatā.
gujarati_transliteration: Darroj jagatnā nāshvant-panānu anusandhān karvu ane potānā ātmāni nityatā tathā sachchidānand-panānu chintvan karvu. (151)
english_translation: Daily, one should reflect on the imper manent nature of the world and on one’s ātmā as eternal and sachchidānand. (151)

sanskrit_transliteration: Bhūtam yach-cha bhavad yach-cha yad-evā’gre bhavishyati; Sarvam tan me hitāyaiva Swāminārāyaṇechchhayā.
gujarati_transliteration: Je thai gayu chhe, thai rahyu chhe ane je kāi āgal thashe te badhu ja Swaminarayan Bhagwanni ichchhāthi mārā hit māte ja chhe em mānvu. (152)
english_translation: One should understand that all which has happened, which is happening, and which will happen is solely due to Swaminarayan Bhagwan’s will and only for my benefit. (152)

sanskrit_transliteration: Prārthanam pratyaham kuryād vishvāsa-bhakti-bhāvataha; Guror Brahmaswarūpasya Swāminārāyaṇa-Prabhoho.
gujarati_transliteration: Swaminarayan Bhagwan tathā brahmaswarup gurune pratidin vishvās ane bhaktibhāvthi prārthanā karvi. (153)
english_translation: One should daily pray to Swaminarayan Bhagwan and the Brahmaswarup guru with faith and devotion. (153)

sanskrit_transliteration: Mānershyā-kāma-krodhādi- doshā’vego bhavet tadā; Aksharam-aham ityādi shānta-manā vichintayet.
gujarati_transliteration: Mān, irshā, kām, krodh ityādi doshono āveg āve tyāre ‘Hu Akshar chhu, Purushottamno dās chhu’ em shānt mane chintvan karvu. (154)
english_translation: When one experiences impulses of egotism, jealousy, lust, anger, and other base instincts, one should calmly reflect: ‘I am akshar; I am a servant of Purushottam.’ (154)

sanskrit_transliteration: Mayā saha sadaivā’sti sarva-dosha-nivārakaha; Swāminārāyaṇah sākshād evam balam cha dhārayet.
gujarati_transliteration: Ane sarva doshonu nivāran karnārā sākshāt Swaminarayan Bhagwan sadaiva māri sāthe chhe em bal rākhvu. (155)
english_translation: Also, one should remain strong in the belief that Swaminarayan Bhagwan himself, who is the destroyer of all base instincts, is always with me. (155)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Sva-dharmam pālayen-nityam para-dharmam pari-tyajet; Sva-dharmo Bhagavad-gurvor āgnāyāh pari-pālanam.
Tad-āgnām yat pari-tyajya kriyate sva-mano-dhrutam; Para-dharmah sa vigneyo vivekibhir mumukshubhihi.
gujarati_transliteration: Swadharmanu sadā pālan karvu. Pardharmano tyāg karvo. Bhagwan ane guruni āgnānu pālan karvu te swadharma chhe. Temni āgnāno tyāg kari potānā mannu dhāryu karvāmā āve tene viveki mumukshue pardharma jānvo. (156–157)
english_translation: One should always observe swadharma and renounce pardharma. Swadharma means to observe the commands of Bhagwan and the guru. The wise mumukshu should realize that pardharma is disregarding their instructions and acting wilfully. (156–157)

sanskrit_transliteration: Satsanga-niyamād yaddhi viruddham dharma-lopakam; Fala-dam api nā’charyam bhaved yad bhakti-bādhakam.
gujarati_transliteration: Je karma fal āpe tevu hoy tem chhatā bhaktimā bādh kartu hoy, satsangnā niyamthi viruddha hoy tathā je ācharvāthi dharmano lop thato hoy tevā karmanu ācharan na karvu. (158)
english_translation: One should avoid even [apparently] beneficial actions that impede devotion, transgress the niyams of satsang or cause one to lapse from dharma. (158)

sanskrit_transliteration: Ādareṇa praṇāmaish-cha madhura-vachanādibhihi; Yatho-chitam hi sanmānyā vruddhā gnāna-vayo-guṇaihi.
gujarati_transliteration: Vaye karine, jnāne karine ke gune karine je motā hoy temnu ādar thaki pranām tathā madhur-vachanādike karine yathochit sanmān karvu. (159)
english_translation: One should offer appropriate respect to those who are senior in age, possess greater wisdom or are more virtuous by bowing reverently, using polite speech and expressing other forms of regard. (159)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sadaivā’daraṇīyā hi vidvad-varishṭha-shikshakāhā; Yathā-shakti cha sat-kāryāh sādhu-vādādi-karmaṇā.
gujarati_transliteration: Vidvāno, vadilo tathā adhyāpakone sadā ādar āpvo. Sārā vachan ādi kriyāo dvārā potāni shakti pramāne temno satkār karvo. (160)
english_translation: One should always respect the learned, seniors and teachers. According to one’s capacity, one should honour them with good words and other such deeds. (160)

sanskrit_transliteration: Jana-sambodhanam kuryād yathā-kārya-guṇādikam; Samvardhayet tad-utsāham yathā-shakti su-karmasu.
gujarati_transliteration: Vyaktinā guna tathā kārya ādine anusāre tenu sambodhan karvu. Yathā-shakti tene sārā kāryomā protsāhan āpvu. (161)
english_translation: One should address each individual according to their virtues, achievements and other merits. One should encourage them in noble works according to their abilities. (161)

sanskrit_transliteration: Satyām vaded hitām chaiva vaded vāṇīm priyām tathā; Mithyā’ropyo’pavādo na kasminsh-chit karhichij-jane.
gujarati_transliteration: Satya, hit ane priya vāni bolvi. Koi manushyani upar kyārey mithyā apvādnu āropan na karvu. (162)
english_translation: One should speak words which are true, beneficial and loving. One should never falsely accuse any individual. (162)

sanskrit_transliteration: Na vadet kutsitām vācham apa-shabda-kalankitām; Shrotru-dukha-karīm nindyām kaṭhorām dvesha-garbhiṇīm.
gujarati_transliteration: Apshabdothi yukta, sāmbhalnārne dukh kare tevi, nindya, kathor ane dvesh bhareli kutsit vāni na bolvi. (163)
english_translation: One should never utter unpleasant speech that is offensive, hurts its listener and is defamatory, harsh or hateful. (163)

sanskrit_transliteration: Asatyam na vadet kvāpi vadet satyam hitā’vaham; Satyam api vaden-naiva yat syād anyā’hitā’vaham.
gujarati_transliteration: Asatya kyārey na bolvu. Hit kare tevu satya bolvu. Anyanu ahit kare tevu satya pan na bolvu. (164)
english_translation: One should never speak untruth. One should express truth that is beneficial, but not utter even truth that may harm others. (164)

sanskrit_transliteration: Anyā’vaguṇa-doshādi- vārtām kadā’pi nochcharet; Tathā krute tvashāntih syād aprītish-cha arer guroho.
gujarati_transliteration: Kyārey koinā avgun ke doshni vāt na karvi. Em karvāthi ashānti thāy ane Bhagwan tathā guruno kurājipo thāy. (165)
english_translation: One should never speak of another’s drawbacks or flaws. Doing so causes unrest and results in the displeasure of Bhagwan and the guru. (165)

sanskrit_transliteration: Atyantā’vashyake nūnam pari-shuddhena bhāvataha; Satya-proktau na doshah syād adhikāra-vatām puraha.
gujarati_transliteration: Atyant āvashyak hoy to pari-shuddha bhāvnāthi adhikrut vyaktine satya kahevāmā dosh nathi. (166)
english_translation: If extremely necessary, it is acceptable to convey the truth with pure intent to an authorized person. (166)

sanskrit_transliteration: Āchāro vā vichāro vā tādruk kāryo na karhichit; Anyeshām ahitam dukham yena syāt klesha-vardhanam.
gujarati_transliteration: Jene karine anyanu ahit thāy, tene dukh thāy ke klesh vadhe tevā āchār ke vichār kyārey na karvā. (167)
english_translation: One should never act or think in a way that is hurtful or damaging to others or that increases conflict. (167)

sanskrit_transliteration: Suhrad-bhāvena bhaktānām shubha-guṇa-gaṇān smaret; Na grāhyo’vaguṇas-teshām drohah kāryo na sarvathā.
gujarati_transliteration: Suhradaybhāv rākhi bhaktonā shubh gunone sambhārvā. Temno avgun na levo ane koi rite droh na karvo. (168)
english_translation: With suhradaybhāv, recollect the virtues of devotees. One should never view their flaws or offend them in any way. (168)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sukhe noch-chhrunkhalo bhūyād dukhe nodvegam āpnuyāt; Swāminārāyaṇechchhātah sarvam pravartate yataha.
gujarati_transliteration: Sukhmā chhaki na javu ane dukhmā udveg na pāmvo. Kāran ke badhu Swaminarayan Bhagwanni ichchhāthi pravarte chhe. (169)
english_translation: In happy times do not get carried away and in unhappy times do not become discouraged, since everything occurs by Swaminarayan Bhagwan’s wish. (169)

sanskrit_transliteration: Vivādah kalaho vā’pi naiva kāryah kadāchana; Vartitavyam vivekena rakshyā shāntish-cha sarvadā.
gujarati_transliteration: Kyārey pan koini sāthe vivād ke kalaha na ja karvo. Hammeshā vivekthi vartvu ane shānti rākhvi. (170)
english_translation: One should never argue or quarrel with anyone. One should always be well- mannered and remain calm. (170)

sanskrit_transliteration: Vachane vartane kvāpi vichāre lekhane tathā; Kaṭhoratām bhajen-naiva janah ko’pi kadāchana.
gujarati_transliteration: Koi pan manushye potānā vachan, vartan, vichār tathā lakhānmā kathortā kyārey na rākhvi. (171)
english_translation: One should never be harsh in speech, action, thought or writing. (171)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sevām mātuh pituh kuryād gruhī satsangam āshritaha; Prati-dinam namaskāram tat-pādeshu nivedayet.
gujarati_transliteration: Gruhastha satsangie matā-pitāni sevā karvi. Pratidin temnā charanomā namaskār karvā. (172)
english_translation: Householder satsangis should serve their mother and father. They should bow to their feet every day. (172)

sanskrit_transliteration: Shvashurah pitruvat sevyo vadhvā shvashrūsh-cha mātruvat; Sva-putrīvat snushā pālyā shvashrvā’pi shvashureṇa cha.
gujarati_transliteration: Vahue sasrāni sevā pitā-tulya gani ane sāsuni sevā mātā-tulya gani karvi. Sāsu- sasrāe pan putra-vadhunu potāni putrini jem pālan karvu. (173)
english_translation: A wife should serve her father-in-law as her own father and mother-in-law as her own mother. A father- and mother-in- law should care for their daughter-in-law as they would for their own daughter. (173)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sampālyāh putra-putryash-cha satsanga-shikshaṇādinā; Anye sambandhinah sevyā yathā-shakti cha bhāvataha.
gujarati_transliteration: Gruhasthoe dikrā-dikrionu satsang, shikshan vagerethi sāri rite poshan karvu. Anya sambandhioni potāni shakti pramāne bhāvthi sevā karvi. (174)
english_translation: Householders should diligently nurture their sons and daughters through satsang, education and other activities. They should affectionately care for their other relatives according to their means. (174)

sanskrit_transliteration: Gruhe hi madhurām vāṇīm vaded vācham tyajet kaṭum; Kam api pīḍitam naiva prakuryād malinā’shayāt.
gujarati_transliteration: Gharmā madhur vāni bolvi. Kadvi vānino tyāg karvo ane malin āshaythi koine pidā na pahonchādvi. (175)
english_translation: One should speak pleasantly at home. One should renounce bitter speech and not harm others with malicious intent. (175)

sanskrit_transliteration: Militvā bhojanam kāryam gruhasthaih sva-gruhe mudā; Atithir hi yathā-shakti sambhāvya āgato gruham.
gujarati_transliteration: Gruhasthoe potānā gharmā bhegā mali ānande bhojan karvu ane ghare padhārelā atithini potāni shakti pramāne sambhāvnā karvi. (176)
english_translation: Householders should joyously eat meals together at home and provide hospitality to guests according to their means. (176)

sanskrit_transliteration: Maraṇādi-prasangeshu kathā-bhajana-kīrtanam; Kāryam visheshatah smāryo hyakshara-Purushottamaha.
gujarati_transliteration: Maran ādi prasangomā vishesh bhajan- kirtan karvu, kathā karvi, Akshar- Purushottam Maharajnu smaran karvu. (177)
english_translation: In the event of a death or other sad occasions, one should perform additional acts of devotion, sing kirtans, engage in discourses and remember Akshar- Purushottam Maharaj. (177)

sanskrit_transliteration: Putrī-putrātmikā svasya sanskāryā santatih sadā; Satsanga-divya-siddhāntaih sad-āchāraish-cha sadguṇaihi.
gujarati_transliteration: Dikri ke dikrā evā potānā santānone satsangnā divya siddhānto, sārā ācharano ane sadguno vade sadā sanskār āpvā. (178)
english_translation: One should always impart sanskārs to one’s sons and daughters by teaching them the divine principles of satsang, good conduct and virtues. (178)

sanskrit_transliteration: Satsanga-shāstra-pāṭhādyair garbha-sthām eva santatim; Sanskuryāt pūrayen-nishṭhām Akshara-Purushottame.
gujarati_transliteration: Santān jyāre garbhamā hoy tyārthi ja tene satsang sambandhi shāstronu vānchan vagere karine sanskār āpvā ane Akshar-Purushottam Maharajne vishe nishthā purvi. (179)
english_translation: From when a child is in the womb, one should instil sanskārs and conviction in Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj by reading the sacred texts of satsang and through other [noble] acts. (179)

sanskrit_transliteration: Kudrashṭyā purushair naiva striyo drashyāh kadāchana; Evam eva kudrashṭyā cha strībhir drashyā na pūrushāhā.
gujarati_transliteration: Purusho kyārey kudrashtie karine strione na jue. Te ja rite strio pan kudrashtie karine purushone na jue. (180)
english_translation: Men should never look at women with a wrong intent. In the same manner, women should also never look at men with a wrong intent. (180)

sanskrit_transliteration: Svīya-patnītarābhis-tu rahasi vasanam saha; Āpat-kālam vinā kvāpi na kuryur gruhiṇo narāhā.
gujarati_transliteration: Gruhasthāshrammā rahyā evā purushoe potāni patni sivāy anya strio sāthe āpatkāl vinā kyay pan ekāntmā na rahevu. (181)
english_translation: Except in emergency situations, married men should never remain alone anywhere with women other than their wife. (181)

sanskrit_transliteration: Tathaiva na hi nāryo’pi tishṭheyuh sva-patītaraihi; Purushaih sākam-ekānte hyāpatti-samayam vinā.
gujarati_transliteration: Te ja rite strioe pan potānā pati sivāy anya purusho sāthe āpatkāl vinā ekāntmā na rahevu. (182)
english_translation: Similarly, [married] women should never remain alone with men other than their husband, except in emergency situations. (182)

sanskrit_transliteration: Narah samīpa-sambandha- hīnām striyam sprushen-na hi; Naiva sprushet tathā nārī tādrusham purushāntaram.
gujarati_transliteration: Purushe samip sambandh vināni strino sparsha na karvo. Te ja rite strie potāne samip sambandh vinānā anya purushno sparsha na karvo. (183)
english_translation: A male should not touch a female who is not closely related; however, he may respectfully touch one who is closely related. Similarly, a female should not touch a male who is not closely related; however, she may respectfully touch one who is closely related. (183)

sanskrit_transliteration: Āpat-kāle’nya-rakshārtham sparshe dosho na vidyate; Anyathā niyamāh pālyā anāpattau tu sarvadā.
gujarati_transliteration: Āpatkāl prāpta thatā anyani rakshā māte sparsha karvāmā dosh nathi. Parantu jo āpatkāl na hoy to sadāy niyamonu pālan karvu. (184)
english_translation: In emergency situations, it is not a fault to touch others to protect or save them. However, if there is no emergency, then always obey the niyams. (184)

sanskrit_transliteration: Ashlīlam yatra drashyam syād dharma-sanskāra-nāshakam; Nāṭaka-chala-chitrādi tan-na pashyet kadāchana.
gujarati_transliteration: Dharma ane sanskārono nāsh kare evā ashlil drashyo jemā āvtā hoy tevā nātako ke chal-chitro vagere kyārey na jovā. (185)
english_translation: One should never view dramas, films or other media that contain obscene scenes which destroy one’s dharma and sanskārs. (185)

sanskrit_transliteration: Manushyo vyasanī yah syād nirlajjo vyabhichāravān; Tasya sango na kartavyah satsangam-āshritair-janaihi.
gujarati_transliteration: Satsangi-janoe je manushya vyasani, nirlajja tathā vyabhichāri hoy teno sang na karvo. (186)
english_translation: Satsangis should not associate with people who have addictions, are shameless or are adulterous. (186)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sangash-chāritrya-hīnāyāh karaṇīyo na hi striyāhā; Strībhih sva-dharma-rakshārtham pālyāsh-cha niyamā draḍham.
gujarati_transliteration: Strioe potānā dharmani rakshā māte chāritryahin strino sang na karvo ane dradhpane niyamonu pālan karvu. (187)
english_translation: To protect one’s dharma, female devotees should not associate with immoral women and should firmly abide by the niyams. (187)

sanskrit_transliteration: Na tādruk-chhruṇuyād vācham gītam grantham paṭhenna cha; Pashyen-na tādrusham drashyam yasmāt kāma-vivardhanam.
gujarati_transliteration: Jene karine kām-vāsanā vruddhi pāme tevi vāto ke gito na sāmbhalvā, pustako na vānchvā tathā tevā drashyo na jovā. (188)
english_translation: One should not listen to talks or songs, read books or view scenes that increase one’s lustful desires. (188)

sanskrit_transliteration: Dhana-dravya-dharādīnām sadā’dāna-pradānayoho; Niyamā lekha-sākshyādeh pālanīyā avashyataha.
gujarati_transliteration: Dhan, dravya tathā jamin ādinā len-denmā hammeshā likhit karvu, sākshie sahit karvu ityādi niyamo avashyapane pālvā. (189)
english_translation: Transactions of wealth, possessions, land and other assets should always be conducted in writing, in the presence of a witness and by definitely following other such niyams. (189)

sanskrit_transliteration: Prasange vyavahārasya sambandhibhir api svakaihi; Lekhādi-niyamāh pālyāh sakalair āshritair janaihi.
gujarati_transliteration: Sarva āshrit janoe potānā sambandhio sāthe pan vyavahār prasange likhit karvu ityādi niyamo pālvā. (190)
english_translation: All devotees should conduct their social dealings with even their relatives in writing and by following other such niyams. (190)

sanskrit_transliteration: Na kāryo vyavahārash-cha dushṭair janaih saha kvachit; Dīna-janeshu bhāvyam cha satsangibhir dayā’nvitaihi.
gujarati_transliteration: Satsangioe kyārey durjan sāthe vyavahār na karvo ane dinjanne vishe dayāvān thavu. (191)
english_translation: Satsangis should never engage in dealings with immoral persons and should be compassionate towards those who are meek and disadvantaged. (191)

sanskrit_transliteration: Laukikam tvavichāryaiva sahasā karma nā’charet; Falādikam vichāryaiva vivekena tad ācharet.
gujarati_transliteration: Laukik kārya kyārey vichāryā vagar tatkāl na karvu parantu fal vagereno vichār karine vivek-purvak karvu. (192)
english_translation: Worldly deeds should never be performed in haste without due deliberation. They should, however, be performed with due judgment, after reflecting on their con sequences and other such considerations. (192)

sanskrit_transliteration: Lunchā kadāpi na grāhyā kaishchid api janair iha; Naiva kāryo vyayo vyarthah kāryah svā’yā’nusārataha.
