gujarati_transliteration: Koi pan manushye kyārey lānch na levi. Dhanno vyartha vyay na karvo. Potāni āvakne anusāre dhanno vyay karvo. (193)
english_translation: No one should ever accept bribes. Wealth should not be spent wastefully. One should spend according to one’s income. (193)

sanskrit_transliteration: Kartavyam lekhanam samyak svasyā’yasya vyayasya cha; Niyamān anusrutyaiva prashāsana-krutān sadā.
gujarati_transliteration: Prashāsannā niyamone anusari hammeshā potānā āvak ane kharchni nondh vyavasthit karvi. (194)
english_translation: One should always accurately keep accounts of one’s income and expenditure in accordance with government laws. (194)

sanskrit_transliteration: Svā’yāddhi dashamo bhāgo vinsho’thavā sva-shaktitaha; Arpyah sevā-prasādārtham Swāminārāyaṇa-Prabhoho.
gujarati_transliteration: Potāne prāpta thati āvakmāthi potāni shakti pramāne dashmo ke vishmo bhāg Swaminarayan Bhagwanni sevā- prasannatā māte arpan karvo. (195)
english_translation: According to one’s means, one should give one-tenth or one-twentieth of one’s income in Swaminarayan Bhagwan’s service and to attain his blessings. (195)

sanskrit_transliteration: Svopayogā’nusāreṇa prakuryāt sangraham gruhī; Anna-dravya-dhanādīnām kāla-shaktyanusārataha.
gujarati_transliteration: Gruhastha potānā upyogne anusāre tathā samay-shakti anusār anāj, dravya ke dhanādino sangrah kare. (196)
english_translation: Householders should save provisions, money and other possessions according to their needs, circumstances and means. (196)

sanskrit_transliteration: Anna-falādibhish-chaiva yathā-shakti jalādibhihi; Pālitāh pashu-pakshyādyāh sambhāvyā hi yathochitam.
gujarati_transliteration: Pālelā pashu-pakshi vagereni anna, fal, jal ityādi vade yathā-shakti uchit sambhāvnā karvi. (197)
english_translation: According to one’s means, one should provide suitable food, fruits, water and other sustenance for one’s domesticated animals and birds. (197)

sanskrit_transliteration: Dhana-dravya-dharādīnām pradānā’dānayoh punaha; Vishvāsa-hananam naiva kāryam na kapaṭam tathā.
gujarati_transliteration: Dhan, dravya ke bhumi vagereni len- denmā vishvās-ghāt tathā kapat na karvā. (198)
english_translation: One should not betray the trust of or deceive others in transactions involving wealth, objects, land or other commodities. (198)

sanskrit_transliteration: Pradātum karma-kāribhyah pratignātam dhanādikam; Yathā-vācham pradeyam tad nonam deyam kadāchana.
gujarati_transliteration: Karmachārione jetlu dhan ādi āpvānu vachan āpyu hoy te vachan pramāne te dhan ādi āpvu pan kyārey ochhu na āpvu. (199)
english_translation: One should pay employees the amount of money or other forms of remuneration agreed upon, but should never give less. (199)

sanskrit_transliteration: Naiva vishvāsa-ghātam hi kuryāt satsangam āshritaha; Pālayed vachanam dattam pratignātam na langhayet.
gujarati_transliteration: Satsangie vishvās-ghāt na karvo. Āpelu vachan pālvu. Pratignānu ullanghan na karvu. (200)
english_translation: A satsangi should not commit betrayal. One should uphold one’s promise. A pledge should not be broken. (200)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Prashāstā pālayed dharmān- niyatā ye sushāsane; Lokānām bharaṇam pushṭim kuryāt sanskāra-rakshaṇam.
Svāsthya-shikshaṇa-samrakshā- vidyud-anna-jalādikaihi; Su-vyavasthā vidhātavyā sarvā’bhyudaya-hetunā.
gujarati_transliteration: Sushāsan māte avashya-pane joie te dharmone prashāsake pālvā. Lokonu bharan-poshan karvu. Sanskāroni rakshā karvi. Sarveno abhyuday thāy te māte swāsthya, shikshan, sanrakshan, vijli, anāj, jal vagere dvārā sāri rite vyavasthā karvi. (201–202)
english_translation: Rulers should follow dharma that is necessary to govern well. They should provide for the people, foster their growth and safeguard sanskārs. They should suitably arrange services for health, education, defence, electricity, food, water and other resources for the benefit of all. (201–202)

sanskrit_transliteration: Guṇa-sāmarthya-ruchyādi viditvaiva janasya tu; Tad-uchiteshu kāryeshu yojanīyo vichārya saha.
gujarati_transliteration: Koi pan manushyanā guna, sāmarthya, ruchi vagere jānine; vichār kari tenā māte uchit evā kāryomā tene jodvo. (203)
english_translation: A person should be assigned suitable tasks after knowing and considering their qualities, abilities, inclinations and other such factors. (203)

sanskrit_transliteration: Shakyā Bhagavato yatra bhaktih sva-dharma-pālanam; Tasmin deshe nivāso hi karaṇīyah sukhena cha.
gujarati_transliteration: Je deshne vishe Bhagwanni bhakti thai shake tathā potānā dharmanu pālan thai shake tevā deshne vishe sukhe nivās karvo. (204)
english_translation: One should happily reside in a country where one can worship Bhagwan and observe one’s dharma. (204)

sanskrit_transliteration: Vidyā-dhanādikam prāptum deshāntaram gate’pi cha; Satsangam ādarāt tatra kuryān-niyama-pālanam.
gujarati_transliteration: Vidyā, dhan ādini prāpti māte deshāntarmā jāy tyāre tyā pan ādarthi satsang karvo ane niyamonu pālan karvu. (205)
english_translation: A person who migrates elsewhere for educational, economic or other gains should continue to reverently practise satsang and observe niyams. (205)

sanskrit_transliteration: Yad-deshe hi sva-vāsah syāt tad-desha-niyamāsh-cha ye; Sarvathā pālanīyāste tat-prashāsana-sammatāha.
gujarati_transliteration: Je deshmā pote rahetā hoy te deshnā prashāsanne sammat niyamonu sarva rite pālan karvu. (206)
english_translation: In the country one resides, one should observe the prescribed laws of that country in every way. (206)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sanjāte desha-kālāder vaiparītye tu dhairyataha; Antar-bhajeta sānandam Akshara-Purushottamam.
gujarati_transliteration: Jyāre desh-kālādinu viprit-panu thai āve tyāre dhiraj rākhi Akshar-Purushottam Maharajnu ānand sāthe antarmā bhajan karvu. (207)
english_translation: During adverse times, one should keep patience and joyously worship Akshar- Purushottam Maharaj within. (207)

sanskrit_transliteration: Āpat-kāle tu samprāpte svīya-vāsa-sthale tadā; Tam desham hi pari-tyajya stheyam deshāntare sukham.
gujarati_transliteration: Pote je sthānmā rahetā hoy te sthale āpatkāl āvi pade tyāre te deshno tyāg kari anya deshne vishe sukhe nivās karvo. (208)
english_translation: If unfavourable circumstances arise where one lives, one should leave that place and live happily elsewhere. (208)

sanskrit_transliteration: Kāryam bālaish-cha bālābhir bālyād vidyā’bhi-prāpaṇam; Durāchārah kusangash-cha tyājyāni vyasanāni cha.
gujarati_transliteration: Nānā bālako tathā bālikāoe bālpanthi ja vidyā prāpta karvi. Durāchār, kusang ane vyasanono tyāg karvo. (209)
english_translation: Young boys and girls should acquire education from childhood. They should avoid inappropriate behaviour, bad company and addictions. (209)

sanskrit_transliteration: Utsāhād ādarāt kuryāt svā’bhyāsam sthira-chetasā; Vyarthatām na nayet kālam vidyārthī vyartha-karmasu.
gujarati_transliteration: Vidyārthie potāno abhyās sthir chitte, utsāhthi ane ādar thaki karvo. Samayne vyartha karmomā bagādvo nahi. (210)
english_translation: Students should study with concentration, enthusiasm and respect. They should not waste their time in useless activities. (210)

sanskrit_transliteration: Bālyād eva draḍhī-kuryāt sevā-vinamratādikam; Nirbalatām bhayam chā’pi naiva gachchhet kadāchana.
gujarati_transliteration: Bālpanthi ja sevā, vinamratā vagere dradh karvā. Kyārey nirbal na thavu ane bhay na pāmvo. (211)
english_translation: From childhood, one should strengthen the virtues of sevā, humility and other virtues. One should never lose courage or be fearful. (211)

sanskrit_transliteration: Bālyād eva hi satsangam kuryād bhaktim cha prārthanām; Kāryā prati-dinam pūjā pitroh panchānga-vandanā.
gujarati_transliteration: Bālpanthi ja satsang, bhakti ane prārthanā karvā. Pratidin pujā karvi tathā mātā- pitāne panchāng pranām karvā. (212)
english_translation: From childhood, one should practise satsang, offer devotion and pray. One should daily perform puja and offer panchāng pranāms to one’s mother and father. (212)

sanskrit_transliteration: Vishesha-sayamah pālyah kaumārye yauvane tathā; Ayogya-sparsha-drashyādyās- tyājyāh shakti-vināshakāhā.
gujarati_transliteration: Kumār tathā yuvān avasthāmā vishesh saiyam pālvo. Shaktino nāsh kare evā ayogya sparsha, drashya vagereno tyāg karvo. (213)
english_translation: During adolescence and early adulthood, one should exercise greater self-control and refrain from improper physical contact, sights and other activities that destroy one’s energies [physical, mental and spiritual]. (213)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sat-falonnāyakam kuryād uchitam eva sāhasam; Na kuryāt kevalam yaddhi sva-mano-loka-ranjakam.
gujarati_transliteration: Sārā falne āpe tevu, unnati kare tevu ane uchit hoy tevu ja sāhas karvu. Je keval potānā mannu ane lokonu ranjan kare tevu sāhas na karvu. (214)
english_translation: One should only undertake ventures that are appropriate and lead to good outcomes and development. However, one should not engage in ventures that merely entertain one’s mind or gratify others. (214)

sanskrit_transliteration: Niyatodyama-kartavye nā’lasyam āpnuyāt kvachit; Shraddhām prītim Harau kuryāt pūjām satsangam anvaham.
gujarati_transliteration: Potāne avashya karvānā udyamne vishe kyārey ālas na karvi. Bhagwanne vishe shraddhā ane priti karvi. Pratidin pujā karvi ane satsang karvo. (215)
english_translation: One should never be lazy in undertaking one’s important tasks. One should have faith in and love towards Bhagwan. One should daily perform puja and do satsang. (215)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sango’tra balavāl-loke yathā-sangam hi jīvanam; Satām sangam atah kuryāt kusangam sarvathā tyajet.
gujarati_transliteration: Ā lokmā sang balvān chhe. Jevo sang hoy tevu jivan bane. Āthi sārā manushyono sang karvo. Kusangno sarvathā tyāg karvo. (216)
english_translation: In this world, the company one keeps has great influence. The type of association moulds one’s life accordingly. Therefore, one should always keep the company of virtuous people and totally shun bad company. (216)

sanskrit_transliteration: Kāmā’sakto bhaved yo hi krutaghno loka-vanchakaha; Pākhaṇḍī kapaṭī yash-cha tasya sangam pari-tyajet.
gujarati_transliteration: Je manushya kāmāsakta, krutaghni, lokone chhetarnār, pākhandi tathā kapti hoy teno sang tyajvo. (217)
english_translation: One should renounce the company of those who are lustful, ungrateful, dishonest, hypocritical or deceitful. (217)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Hares-tad-avatārāṇām khaṇḍanam vidadhāti yaha; Upāsteh khaṇḍanam yash-cha kurute Paramātmanaha.
Sākrutikam Parabrahma manute yo nirākruti; Tasya sango na kartavyas- tādrug-granthān paṭhen-na hi.
gujarati_transliteration: Je manushya Bhagwan ane temnā avatāronu khandan karto hoy, Paramatmani upāsanānu khandan karto hoy ane sākār Bhagwanne nirākār mānto hoy teno sang na karvo. Tevā grantho na vānchvā. (218–219)
english_translation: One should not associate with those who deny Bhagwan and his incarnations, disapprove of upāsanā to Paramatma or believe Bhagwan, who eternally possesses a form, to be formless. Do not read such texts. (218–219)

sanskrit_transliteration: Khaṇḍanam mandirāṇām yo mūrtīnām kurute Harehe; Satyā’hinsādi-dharmāṇām tasya sangam pari-tyajet.
gujarati_transliteration: Je manushya mandir ane Bhagwanni murtionu khandan karto hoy, satya- ahinsā ādi dharmonu khandan karto hoy tenā sangno tyāg karvo. (220)
english_translation: One should renounce the company of those who decry mandirs and Bhagwan’s murtis or denounce truth, non-violence and other such righteous conduct. (220)

sanskrit_transliteration: Gurvāshraya-virodhī yo vaidika-shāstra-khaṇḍakaha; Bhakti-mārga-virodhī syāt tasya sangam na chā’charet.
gujarati_transliteration: Je manushya guru-sharanāgatino virodh karto hoy, vaidik shāstronu khandan karto hoy, bhaktimārgno virodh karto hoy teno sang na karvo. (221)
english_translation: One should not associate with those who oppose taking refuge in a guru, Vedic texts or the path of bhakti. (221)

sanskrit_transliteration: Buddhimān api loke syād vyāvahārika-karmasu; Na sevyo bhakti-hīnash-chech- chhāstra-pārangato’pi vā.
gujarati_transliteration: Koi manushya lokmā vyāvahārik kāryomā buddhivālo hoy athvā shāstromā pārangat pan hoy, tem chhatā pan jo te bhaktie rahit hoy to teno sang na karvo. (222)
english_translation: One should avoid the company of a person who is devoid of devotion, even if such a person is intelligent in worldly activities or learned in the shastras. (222)

sanskrit_transliteration: Shraddhām eva tiras-krutya hyādhyātmikeshu kevalam; Puras-karoti yas-tarkam tat-sangam ācharen-na hi.
gujarati_transliteration: Ādhyātmik vishayomā shraddhāno ja tiraskār kari je manushya keval tarkne ja āgal karto hoy teno sang na karvo. (223)
english_translation: One should not associate with those who ridicule faith in spiritual matters and promote logic alone. (223)

sanskrit_transliteration: Satsange’pi kusango yo gneyah so’pi mumukshubhihi; Tat-sangash-cha na kartavyo haribhaktaih kadāchana.
gujarati_transliteration: Mumukshu haribhaktoe satsangmā rahel kusangne pan jānvo ane kyārey teno sang na karvo. (224)
english_translation: Mumukshu devotees should also recognize kusang within satsang and should never associate with it. (224)

sanskrit_transliteration: Harau gurau cha pratyakshe manushya-bhāva-darshanaha; Shithilo niyame yash-cha na tasya sangam ācharet.
gujarati_transliteration: Je manushya pratyaksha Bhagwanmā ane gurumā manushyabhāv joto hoy ane niyam pālvāmā shithil hoy teno sang na karvo. (225)
english_translation: One should avoid the company of those who are lax in observing niyams or see human traits in the manifest form of Bhagwan or the guru. (225)

sanskrit_transliteration: Bhakteshu dosha-drashṭih syād avaguṇaika-bhāshakaha; Manasvī yo guru-drohī na cha tat-sangam ācharet.
gujarati_transliteration: Je manushya bhaktomā dosh jonār, avgunni ja vāto karnār, manasvi ane gurudrohi hoy teno sang na karvo. (226)
english_translation: One should avoid the company of those who perceive drawbacks in devotees, speak only ill of others, are wilful or disobey the guru. (226)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sat-kārya-nindako yash-cha sach-chhāstra-nindako janaha; Satsanga-nindako yash-cha tat-sangam ācharen-na hi.
gujarati_transliteration: Je manushya satkārya, sach-chhāstra tathā satsangni nindā karto hoy teno sang na karvo. (227)
english_translation: One should not associate with those who defame noble works, sacred texts or satsang. (227)

sanskrit_transliteration: Vachanānām shruter yasya nishṭhāyā bhanjanam bhavet; Gurau Harau cha satsange tasya sangam pari-tyajet.
gujarati_transliteration: Jeni vāto sāmbhalvāthi Bhagwan, guru tathā satsangne vishe nishthā talti hoy teno sang tyajvo. (228)
english_translation: One should shun the company of those whose words weaken one’s conviction in Bhagwan, the guru or satsang. (228)

sanskrit_transliteration: Bhaved yo draḍha-nishṭhāvān Akshara-Purushottame; Draḍha-bhaktir vivekī cha kuryāt tat-sangam ādarāt.
gujarati_transliteration: Jene Akshar-Purushottamne vishe dradh nishthā hoy, dradh bhakti hoy ane je viveki hoy teno sang ādar thaki karvo. (229)
english_translation: One should respectfully associate with a person who has firm devotion and conviction in Akshar-Purushottam and who is discerning. (229)

sanskrit_transliteration: Harer gurosh-cha vākyeshu shankā yasya na vidyate; Vishvāsur buddhimān yash-cha kuryāt tat-sangam ādarāt.
gujarati_transliteration: Bhagwan tathā gurunā vākyomā jene sanshay na hoy, je vishvāsu hoy, buddhimān hoy teno sang ādar thaki karvo. (230)
english_translation: One should respectfully associate with those who do not doubt the words of Bhagwan or the guru, and are trustworthy and wise. (230)

sanskrit_transliteration: Āgnāyāh pālane nityam sotsāham tat-paro draḍhaha; Nirmānaha saralo yash-cha kuryāt tat-sangam ādarāt.
gujarati_transliteration: Āgnā pālvāmā je sadāy utsāh sāthe tatpar hoy, dradh hoy; je nirmāni tathā saral hoy teno sang ādar thaki karvo. (231)
english_translation: One should respectfully associate with those who always eagerly follow commands with enthusiasm and determination, and are humble and cooperative. (231)

sanskrit_transliteration: Harer gurosh-charitreshu divyeshu mānusheshu yaha; Sa-sneham divyatā-darshī kuryāt tat-sangam ādarāt.
gujarati_transliteration: Bhagwan ane gurunā divya tathā manushya charitromā je sneh-purvak divyatānu darshan karto hoy teno sang ādar thaki karvo. (232)
english_translation: One should respectfully associate with those who lovingly see divinity in both the divine and human-like actions of Bhagwan and the guru. (232)

sanskrit_transliteration: Tat-paro’nya-guṇa-grāhe vimukho dur-guṇoktitaha; Suhrad-bhāvī cha satsange kuryāt tat-sangam ādarāt.
gujarati_transliteration: Satsangmā je manushya anyanā guno grahan karvāmā tatpar hoy, durgunoni vāt na karto hoy, suhradbhāv-vālo hoy teno sang ādar thaki karvo. (233)
english_translation: One should respectfully associate with those in satsang who eagerly imbibe the virtues of others, never speak about others’ flaws and keep suhradbhāv. (233)

sanskrit_transliteration: Lakshyam yasyaika-mātram syād Guruhari-prasannatā; Āchāre’pi vichāre’pi kuryāt tat-sangam ādarāt.
gujarati_transliteration: Jenā āchār tathā vichārne vishe guruharine rāji karvānu ekmātra lakshya hoy teno sang ādar thaki karvo. (234)
english_translation: One should respectfully associate with a person whose conduct and thoughts aim solely to please the guru. (234)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sva-sampradāya-granthānām yathā-shakti yathā-ruchi; Sanskrute prākrute vā’pi kuryāt paṭhana-pāṭhane.
gujarati_transliteration: Potāni shakti ane ruchi pramāne Sanskrit tathā prākrut bhāshāmā potānā Sampra daynā granthonu pathan-pāthan karvu. (235)
english_translation: One should study and teach the Sanskrit or vernacular texts of one’s Sampradaya according to one’s abilities and preferences. (235)

sanskrit_transliteration: Swāmi-vārtāh paṭhen-nityam tathaiva Vachanāmrutam; Guṇātīta-gurūṇām cha charitam bhāvatah paṭhet.
gujarati_transliteration: Vachanamrut, Swamini Vato tathā Gunatit guruonā jivan-charitro nitye bhāvthi vānchvā. (236)
english_translation: One should daily read the Vachanamrut, Swamini Vato and the jivan charitras of the Gunatit gurus with adoration. (236)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Upadeshāsh-charitrāṇi Swāminārāyaṇa-Prabhoho; Guṇātīta-gurūṇām cha satsanginām hi jīvanam.
Atas-tach-chhravaṇam kuryād mananam nidi-dhyāsanam; Mahimnā shraddhayā bhaktyā pratyaham shānta-chetasā.
gujarati_transliteration: Swaminarayan Bhagwan tathā Gunatit guruonā updesho ane charitro satsangionu jivan chhe. Tethi satsangie tenu shānt chitte shravan, manan tathā nididhyāsan mahimāe sahit, shraddhā-purvak tathā bhaktithi roj karvu. (237–238)
english_translation: The teachings and actions of Swaminarayan Bhagwan and the Gunatit gurus are the very life of satsangis. Therefore, satsangis should, with a calm mind, listen to, contemplate on and repeatedly recall them daily with mahimā, faith and devotion. (237–238)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sāmpradāyika-siddhānta- bādhakaram hi yad vachaha; Paṭhyam shravyam na mantavyam sanshayotpādakam cha yat.
gujarati_transliteration: Sampradaynā siddhāntomā bādh kare tathā sanshay utpanna kare tevā vachano vānchvā, sāmbhalvā ke manvā nahi. (239)
english_translation: One should not read, listen to or believe words that go against the Sampradaya’s principles or raise doubts. (239)

sanskrit_transliteration: Swāminārāyaṇe bhaktim parām draḍhayitum hradi; Guruhareh samādeshāch chāturmāsye vratam charet.
gujarati_transliteration: Swaminarayan Bhagwanne vishe hradaymā parā-bhakti dradh karvā guruharinā ādeshthi chāturmāsmā vrat karvu. (240)
english_translation: To reinforce profound devotion towards Swaminarayan Bhagwan in one’s heart, one should observe vows during chāturmās according to the guru’s instructions. (240)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Chāndrāyaṇopavāsādir mantra-japah pradakshiṇāhā; Kathā-shrutir daṇḍavach-cha praṇāmā adhikās-tadā.
Ityevam ādirūpeṇa shraddhayā prīti-pūrvakam; Hari-prasannatām prāptum visheshām bhaktim ācharet.
gujarati_transliteration: Temā chāndrāyan, upvās vagere tathā mantra-jap, pradakshinā, kathā-shravan, adhik dandvat pranām karvā ityādirupe shraddhāe karine, priti-purvak ane Bhagwanno rājipo prāpta karvā vishesh bhaktinu ācharan karvu. (241–242)
english_translation: This includes observing chāndrāyan and other fasts, as well as chanting the [Swaminarayan] mantra, performing pradakshinās, listening to spiritual discourses, offering extra dandvat pranāms, and additional devotion with faith, love and the wish to please Bhagwan. (241–242)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sampradāyasya shāstrāṇām paṭhanam pāṭhanam tadā; Yathā-ruchi yathā-shakti kuryād niyama-pūrvakam.
gujarati_transliteration: Tyāre potāni ruchi tathā shakti pramāne Sampradaynā shāstronu niyam-purvak pathan-pāthan karvu. (243)
english_translation: During this time, one should also regularly read and teach the Sampradaya’s shastras according to one’s preference and ability. (243)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sarvaih satsangibhih kāryāh prītim vardhayitum arau; Utsavā bhakti-bhāvena harsheṇollāsatas-tathā.
gujarati_transliteration: Bhagwanne vishe priti vadhārvā sāru sarve satsangioe harsh ane ullāsthi bhaktibhāve utsavo karvā. (244)
english_translation: To increase their love for Bhagwan, all satsangis should celebrate festivals with great joy and devotion. (244)

sanskrit_transliteration: Janma-mahotsavā nityam Swāminārāyaṇa-Prabhoho; Brahmā’kshara-gurūṇām cha kartavyā bhakti-bhāvataha.
gujarati_transliteration: Bhagwan Swaminarayan tathā Akshar brahma guruonā janma-mahotsavo bhakti bhāvthi hammeshā ujavavā. (245)
english_translation: The birth festivals of Bhagwan Swami narayan and the Aksharbrahma gurus should always be celebrated with devotion. (245)

sanskrit_transliteration: Harer guror vishishṭānām prasangānām dineshu cha; Satsangibhir yathā-shakti kāryāh parvotsavā janaihi.
gujarati_transliteration: Satsangi janoe Shri Hari tathā gurunā vishishta prasangone divase yathā-shakti parvotsavo karvā. (246)
english_translation: According to their means, satsangis should celebrate festivals to commemorate the special days related to Shri Hari and the gurus. (246)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sa-vādyam kīrtanam kāryam parvotsaveshu bhaktitaha; Mahimnash-cha kathā-vārtā karaṇīyā visheshataha.
gujarati_transliteration: Parvotsavone vishe bhaktie karine savādya kirtan karvu ane visheshe karine mahimāni vāto karvi. (247)
english_translation: During festivals, satsangis should devoutly sing kirtans to the accompaniment of instruments and especially discourse on the glory [of Bhagwan and guru]. (247)

sanskrit_transliteration: Chaitra-shukla-navamyām hi kāryam Shrī-Rāma-pūjanam; Krishṇā’shṭamyām tu kartavyam Shrāvaṇe Krishṇa-pūjanam.
gujarati_transliteration: Chaitra sud nomne divase Ramchandra Bhagwannu pujan karvu. Shravan vad āthamne divase Krishna Bhagwannu pujan karvu. (248)
english_translation: On the day of Chaitra sud 9, one should offer pujan to Ramchandra Bhagwan. On the day of Shravan vad 8, one should offer pujan to Krishna Bhagwan. (248)

sanskrit_transliteration: Shiva-rātrau hi kartavyam pūjanam Shankarasya cha; Gaṇesham Bhādra-shuklāyām chaturthyām pūjayet tathā.
gujarati_transliteration: Shivratrine vishe Shankar Bhagwannu pujan karvu. Bhadarva sud chothne divase Ganpatinu pujan karvu. (249)
english_translation: On Shivratri, one should offer pujan to Shankar Bhagwan. On Bhadarva sud 4, one should offer pujan to Ganpati. (249)

sanskrit_transliteration: Mārutim Āshvine krushṇa- chaturdashyām hi pūjayet; Mārge mandira-samprāptau tad-devam praṇamed hradā.
gujarati_transliteration: Aso vad chaudashne divas Hanumanjinu pujan karvu. Mārge jatā koi mandir āve to te devane bhāvthi pranām karvā. (250)
english_translation: On Aso vad 14, one should offer pujan to Hanumanji. One should devoutly bow to the deities of any mandir that one comes across. (250)

sanskrit_transliteration: Vishṇush-cha Shankarash-chaiva Pārvatī cha Gajānanaha; Dina-karash-cha panchaitā mānyāh pūjyā hi devatāhā.
gujarati_transliteration: Vishnu, Shankar, Parvati, Ganpati tathā Surya e pānch devtā pujya-pane mānvā. (251)
english_translation: Vishnu, Shankar, Parvati, Ganpati and Surya – these five deities should be revered. (251)

sanskrit_transliteration: Pari-rakshed draḍhām nishṭhām Akshara-Purushottame; Tathā’pi naiva kartavyam devatā’ntara-nindanam.
gujarati_transliteration: Akshar-Purushottam Maharajne vishe dradh nishthā rākhvi. Tem chhatā koi pan anya devoni nindā na karvi. (252)
english_translation: One should have firm conviction in Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj. However, one should not disrespect any other deity. (252)

sanskrit_transliteration: Dharmā vā sampradāyā vā ye’nye tad-anuyāyinaha; Na te dveshyā na te nindyā ādartavyāsh-cha sarvadā.
gujarati_transliteration: Anya dharmo, sampradāyo ke temnā anuyāyione vishe dvesh na karvo. Temni nindā na karvi. Temne sadā ādar āpvo. (253)
english_translation: One should not have contempt for other religions, sampradāyas or their followers. One should never criticize them and should always treat them with respect. (253)

sanskrit_transliteration: Mandirāṇi cha shāstrāṇi santas-tathā kadāchana; Na nindyāste hi satkāryā yathā-shakti yathochitam.
gujarati_transliteration: Mandiro, shāstro ane santoni kyārey nindā na karvi. Potāni shakti pramāne temno yathochit satkār karvo. (254)
english_translation: One should never disrespect mandirs, shastras or sadhus. One should honour them appropriately according to one’s capacity. (254)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sanyam-anopavāsādi yad-yat-tapah samācharet; Prasādāya Hares-tat tu bhaktyartham eva kevalam.
gujarati_transliteration: Saiyam, upvās ityādi je je tapnu ācharan karvu te to keval Bhagwanne rāji karvā tathā bhakti māte ja karvu. (255)
english_translation: Whichever acts of self-control, fasts and other austerities are undertaken, they should be performed only as bhakti and with the intent to solely please Bhagwan. (255)

sanskrit_transliteration: Ekādashyā vratam nityam kartavyam param-ādarāt; Tad-dine naiva bhoktavyam nishiddham vastu karhichit.
gujarati_transliteration: Ekādashinu vrat sadāy param ādar thaki karvu. Te divase nishiddha vastu kyārey na jamvi. (256)
english_translation: One should always observe the ekādashi fast with utmost reverence. On this day, prohi bited items should never be consumed. (256)

sanskrit_transliteration: Upavāse divā-nidrām prayatnatah pari-tyajet; Divasa-nidrayā nashyed upavāsātmakam tapaha.
gujarati_transliteration: Upvāsne vishe divasni nidrāno prayatna- purvak tyāg karvo. Divase lidheli nidrāthi upvās-rupi tap nāsh pāme chhe. (257)
english_translation: While fasting, one should endeavour to give up sleep during daytime. Sleeping during daytime destroys the merits earned by the austerity of fasting. (257)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Swāminārāyaṇeneha svayam yaddhi prasāditam; Gurubhish-chā’kshara-Brahma- swarūpair yat prasāditam.
Teshām sthāna-visheshāṇām yātrām kartum ya ichchhati; Tad yātrām sa janah kuryād yathā-shakti yathā-ruchi.
gujarati_transliteration: Bhagwan Swaminarayane pote je sthānone prasādibhut karyā chhe, Aksharbrahma swarup guruoe je sthānone prasādibhut karyā chhe, te sthānoni yātrā karvāni ichchhā hoy tene potāni shakti ane ruchi pramāne karvi. (258–259)
english_translation: If one desires to go on a pilgrimage to the places sanctified by Bhagwan Swami narayan or the Aksharbrahma gurus, one should do so according to one’s means and preferences. (258–259)

sanskrit_transliteration: Ayodhyām Mathurām Kāshīm Kedāram Badarīm vrajet; Rāmeshvarādi tīrtham cha yathā-shakti yathā-ruchi.
gujarati_transliteration: Ayodhya, Mathura, Kashi, Kedarnath, Badrinath tathā Rameshwar ityādi tirthoni yātrāe potāni shakti ane ruchi pramāne javu. (260)
english_translation: One may go on a pilgrimage to Ayodhya, Mathura, Kashi, Kedarnath, Badrinath, Rameshwar and other sacred places according to one’s means and preferences. (260)

sanskrit_transliteration: Maryādā pālanīyaiva sarvair mandiram āgataihi; Nāryo naiva naraih sprushyā nārībhish-cha narās-tathā.
gujarati_transliteration: Mandirmā āvel sau koie maryādānu pālan avashya karvu. Mandirne vishe āvel purushoe strino sparsha na karvo tathā strioe purushno sparsha na karvo. (261)
english_translation: After arriving at the mandir, all should certainly follow its disciplines. Males should not touch females and females should not touch males. (261)

sanskrit_transliteration: Niyamam anusrutyaiva satsangasya tu mandire; Vastrāṇi pari-dheyāni strībhih pumbhish-cha sarvadā.
gujarati_transliteration: Strio tathā purushoe hammeshā satsangnā niyam anusār mandirne vishe vastro pahervā. (262)
english_translation: At the mandir, males and females should always dress according to the norms of satsang. (262)

sanskrit_transliteration: Gachchhed yadā darshanārtham bhakta-jano Harer guroho; Riktena pāṇinā naiva gachchhet tadā kadāchana.
gujarati_transliteration: Bhaktajane Bhagwan ke gurunā darshane kyārey khāli hāthe na javu. (263)
english_translation: A devotee should never go empty-handed for the darshan of Bhagwan or the guru. (263)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Āditya-chandrayor grāha- kāle satsangibhih samaihi; Pari-tyajya kriyāh sarvāh kartavyam bhajanam Harehe.
Nidrām cha bhojanam tyaktvā tadaikatropavishya cha; Kartavyam grāha-muktyantam Bhagavat-kīrtanādikam.
gujarati_transliteration: Sarve satsangioe surya ke chandranā grahan kāle sarva kriyāono tyāg kari Bhagwannu bhajan karvu. Te samaye nidrā tathā bhojanno tyāg karine ek sthale besine grahan purna thāy tyā sudhi bhagvat-kirtanādi karvu. (264–265)
english_translation: During a solar or lunar eclipse, all satsangis should discontinue all activities and engage in Bhagwan’s bhajan. During that time, one should not sleep or eat, but sit in one place to sing kirtans dedicated to Bhagwan and undertake other forms of devotion until the eclipse is over. (264–265)

sanskrit_transliteration: Grāha-muktau sa-vastram hi kāryam snānam samair janaihi; Tyāgibhish-cha Harih pūjyo deyam dānam gruhasthitaihi.
gujarati_transliteration: Grahanni mukti thaye sarva janoe savastra snān karvu. Tyāgioe Bhagwanni pujā karvi ane gruhasthoe dān karvu. (266)
english_translation: When the eclipse is over, all should bathe and soak the clothes they are wearing. Thereafter, renunciants should perform puja and house- holder devotees should give donations. (266)

sanskrit_transliteration: Janmano maraṇasyā’pi vidhayah sūtakādayaha; Satsanga-rītim āshritya pālyāh shrāddhā-dayas-tathā.
gujarati_transliteration: Janma-maranni sutak tathā shrāddh vagere vidhio satsangni ritne anusari pālvi. (267)
english_translation: One should perform rituals related to birth, death and shrāddh according to the Satsang tradition. (267)

sanskrit_transliteration: Prāyash-chittam anushṭheyam jāte tvayogya-vartane; Paramātma-prasādārtham shuddhena bhāvatas-tadā.
gujarati_transliteration: Koi ayogya ācharan thai jāy tyāre Bhagwanne rāji karvā shuddha bhāve prāyashchit karvu. (268)
english_translation: If one has acted immorally, one should piously atone to please Bhagwan. (268)

sanskrit_transliteration: Āpat-kāle tu satyeva hyāpado dharmam ācharet; Alpāpattim mahāpattim matvā dharmam na san-tyajet.
gujarati_transliteration: Āpatkālmā ja āpad-dharma ācharvo. Alp āpattine moti āpatti māni lai dharmano tyāg na karvo. (269)
english_translation: One should follow the rules described for emergencies only in times of crisis. Do not give up one’s dharma by considering minor difficulties to be major. (269)

sanskrit_transliteration: Āpattau kashṭa-dāyām tu rakshā svasya parasya cha; Yathaiva syāt tathā kāryam rakshatā Bhagavad-balam.
gujarati_transliteration: Kashta āpe tevi āpatti āvi pade tyāre Bhagwannu bal rākhi je rite potāni tathā anyani rakshā thāy tem karvu. (270)
english_translation: When agonizing calamities arise, one should derive strength from Bhagwan and act to protect oneself and others. (270)

sanskrit_transliteration: Āpattau prāṇa-nāshinyām prāptāyām tu vivekinā; Gurvādeshā’nusāreṇa prāṇān rakshet sukham vaset.
gujarati_transliteration: Viveki manushye prānno nāsh thāy tevi āpatti āvi pade tyāre gurunā ādeshone anusarine prānni rakshā karvi ane sukhe rahevu. (271)
english_translation: When faced with circumstances that may result in death, one who is wise should act according to the guru’s teachings to protect one’s life and live contentedly. (271)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Satsanga-rītim āshritya gurvādeshā’nusārataha; Pari-shuddhena bhāvena sarvaih satsangibhir janaihi.
Desham kālam avasthām cha sva-shaktim anusrutya cha; Āchāro vyavahārash-cha prāyash-chittam vidhīyatām.
gujarati_transliteration: Sarve satsangi janoe satsangni rit pramāne, gurunā ādesh anusār, pari-shuddha bhāvthi desh, kāl, avasthā tathā potāni shakti pramāne āchār, vyavahār ane prāyashchit karvā. (272–273)
english_translation: As per their prevailing location, time, age and abilities, all satsangis should genuinely act, atone and engage in dealings according to the traditions of the Satsang and the guru’s instructions. (272–273)

sanskrit_transliteration: Jīvanam unnatim yāti dharma-niyama-pālanāt; Anyashchā’pi sadāchāra- pālane prerito bhavet.
gujarati_transliteration: Dharma-niyam pālvāthi jivan unnat thāy chhe ane anyane pan sadāchār pālvāni prernā male chhe. (274)
english_translation: Observing dharma and niyams elevates the quality of one’s life and also inspires others to live righteously. (274)

sanskrit_transliteration: Bhūta-preta-pishāchāder bhayam kadāpi nā’pnuyāt; Īdruk shankāh pari-tyajya haribhaktah sukham vaset.
gujarati_transliteration: Bhagwannā bhakte kyārey bhut, pret, pishāch ādini bik na rākhvi. Āvi āshankāono tyāg karine sukhe rahevu. (275)
english_translation: Devotees of Bhagwan should never fear evil spirits, such as bhuts, prets or pishāchas. They should give up such apprehensions and live happily. (275)

sanskrit_transliteration: Shubhā’shubha-prasangeshu mahima-sahitam janaha; Pavitrām Sahajānanda- Nāmāvalim paṭhet tathā.
gujarati_transliteration: Shubh tathā ashubh prasangone vishe mahimāe sahit pavitra Sahajanand Namavalino pāth karvo. (276)
english_translation: On auspicious and inauspicious occasions, one should recite the sacred ‘Sahajanand Namavali’ while understanding its glory. (276)

sanskrit_transliteration: Kālo vā karma vā māyā prabhaven-naiva karhichit; Anishṭa-karaṇe nūnam satsangā’shraya-shālinām.
gujarati_transliteration: Jeone satsangno āshray thayo chhe temnu kāl, karma ke māyā kyārey anishta karvā samartha thatā ja nathi. (277)
english_translation: Kāl, karma and māyā can never harm those who have taken refuge in satsang. (277)

sanskrit_transliteration: Ayogya-vishayāsh-chaivam ayogya-vyasanāni cha; Āshankāh sampari-tyājyāh satsangam āshritaih sadā.
gujarati_transliteration: Satsangioe ayogya vishayo, vyasano tathā vahemno sadāy tyāg karvo. (278)
english_translation: Satsangis should always renounce inappropriate indulgence in the sense pleasures, addictions and superstitions. (278)

sanskrit_transliteration: Naiva manyeta kartrutvam kāla-karmādikasya tu; Manyeta sarva-kartāram Akshara-Purushottamam.
gujarati_transliteration: Kāl, karma ādinu kartā-panu na mānvu. Akshar-Purushottam Maharajne sarva- kartā manvā. (279)
english_translation: Do not believe kāl, karma and other factors to be the doers. One should realize Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj as the all- doer. (279)

sanskrit_transliteration: Vipattishu dhared dhairyam prārthanam yatnam ācharet; Bhajeta draḍha-vishvāsam Akshara-Purushottame.
gujarati_transliteration: Vipatti āve tyāre dhiraj rākhvi, prārthanā karvi, prayatna karvo ane Akshar- Purushottam Maharajne vishe dradh vishvās rakhvo. (280)
english_translation: In difficult times, one should remain pa- tient, offer prayers, persevere and keep firm faith in Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj. (280)

sanskrit_transliteration: Tyāgā’shramechchhunā dīkshā grāhyā Brahmā’ksharād guroho; Brahma-charyam sadā sarvaih pālyam tyāgibhir ashṭadhā.
gujarati_transliteration: Tyāgāshram grahan karvāni ichchhā hoy temne Aksharbrahma-swarup guru pāse dikshā grahan karvi. Sarve tyāgioe sadā ashta-prakāre brahmacharya pālvu. (281)
english_translation: Those who wish to join the sadhu āshram should receive initiation from the Aksharbrahma guru. All sadhus should al- ways observe eight-fold brahmacharya. (281)

sanskrit_transliteration: Dhanam tu tyāgibhis-tyājyam rakshyam svīyatayā na cha; Sprushyam naivā’pi vittam cha tyāgibhis-tu kadāchana.
gujarati_transliteration: Tyāgioe dhanno tyāg karvo ane potānu karine rākhvu nahi. Dhanno sparsha pan na ja karvo. (282)
english_translation: Renunciants should renounce money and should not keep it as their own. They should not even touch money. (282)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Tyāgibhih prīti-vruddhyartham Akshara-Purushottame; Nishkāmatvam sadā dhāryam nirlobhatvam sadaiva cha.
Nihsvādatvam sadā dhāryam nihsnehatvam tathaiva cha; Nirmānatvam sadā dhāryam anye cha tyāgino guṇāhā.
gujarati_transliteration: Tyāgioe Akshar-Purushottam Maharajne vishe priti vadhārvā sāru sadā nishkām- panu, nirlobh-panu, nihsvād-panu, nihsneh-panu, nirmān-panu tathā tyāginā anya guno dhāran karvā. (283–284)
english_translation: To increase their love for Akshar- Purushottam Maharaj, renunciants should always imbibe the virtues of nishkām, nirlobh, nihsvād, nihsneh, nirmān, and the other ascetic qualities. (283–284)

sanskrit_transliteration: Svā’tma-brahmaikatām prāpya Swāminārāyaṇo Harihi; Sarvadā bhajanīyo hi tyāgibhir divyabhāvataha.
gujarati_transliteration: Tyāgioe potānā ātmāni Brahma sangāthe ektā prāpta karine divyabhāve sadāy Swaminarayan Bhagwanne bhajvā. (285)
english_translation: Renunciants should identify their ātmā with Brahma and always offer devotion to Swaminarayan Bhagwan with divya bhāv. (285)

sanskrit_transliteration: Tyāgo na kevalam tyāgas- tyāgo bhakti-mayas-tvayam; Pari-tyāgo hyayam prāptum Akshara-Purushottamam.
gujarati_transliteration: Tyāg e keval tyāg ja nathi parantu ā tyāg to bhaktimay chhe. Ā tyāg Akshar- Purushottam Maharajne pāmvā māte chhe. (286)
english_translation: Renunciation is not merely self-denial; it is also endowed with devotion. Such renunciation is for attaining Akshar- Purushottam Maharaj. (286)

sanskrit_transliteration: Āgnopāsana-siddhāntāh sarva-jīva-hitāvahāhā; Dukha-vināshakā ete parama-sukha-dāyakāhā.
gujarati_transliteration: Āgnā-upāsanā sambandhi ā siddhānto sarva-jiva-hitāvaha chhe, dukh-vināshak chhe ane param-sukhdāyak chhe. (287)
english_translation: These principles of āgnā and upāsanā are beneficial to all; they destroy misery and bestow utmost bliss. (287)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Etachchhāstrānusāreṇa yah prītyā shraddhayā janaha; Āgnopāsanayor dārḍhyam prakuryāt svasya jīvane.
Hareh prasannatām prāpya tat-krupā-bhājano bhavet; Jīvan-neva sthitim brāhmīm shāstroktām āpnuyāt sa cha.
Dharmaikāntika sansiddhim āpnute divyam Aksharam; Shāshvatam Bhagavad-dhāma muktim ātyantikīm sukham.
gujarati_transliteration: Ā shāstrane anusarine je jan shraddhā ane pritithi potānā jivanmā āgnā-upāsanāni dradhtā kare, te Bhagwanno rājipo prāpta kari temni krupānu pātra thāy chhe. Shāstromā kahel brāhmi sthitine te jivtā chhatā ja prāpta kare chhe. Ekāntik dharma siddha kare chhe. Bhagwannā shāshvat, divya evā Akshardhamne pāme chhe, ātyantik mukti melve chhe ane sukh prāpta kare chhe. (288–290)
english_translation: Those who faithfully and lovingly strengthen āgnā and upāsanā in their life according to this shastra earn the pleasure of Bhagwan and become a recipient of his grace. While living, they attain the brāhmic state described in the shastras. They master ekāntik dharma. They attain the eternal and divine Akshardham of Bhagwan, ultimate moksha and bliss. (288–290)

sanskrit_transliteration: Aksharabrahma-sādharmyam samprāpya dāsa-bhāvataha; Purushottama-bhaktir hi muktir ātyantikī matā.
gujarati_transliteration: Aksharbrahmanu sādharmya prāpta kari Purushottamni dāsbhāve bhakti karvi e mukti mānvāmā āvi chhe. (291)
english_translation: Attaining oneness with Aksharbrahma and offering humble devotion to Purushottam is considered to be mukti. (291)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sankshipyā’tra krutam hyevam āgnopāsana-varṇanam; Tad vistaram vijānīyāt sāmpradāyika-shāstrataha.
gujarati_transliteration: Ā rite sankshepe karine ahi āgnā tathā upāsanānu varnan karyu. Teno vistār Sampradaynā shāstro thaki jānvo. (292)
english_translation: Here, in this way, āgnā and upāsanā have been concisely described. One should obtain further details from the Sampradaya’s shastras. (292)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Etat-Satsanga-Dīksheti shāstrasya prati-vāsaram; Kāryah satsangibhih pāṭha ekāgra-chetasā janaihi.
Paṭhane chā’samarthais-tu shravyam tat prīti-pūrvakam; Ācharitum cha kartavyah prayatnah shraddhayā tathā.
gujarati_transliteration: Satsangi janoe pratidin ā ‘Satsang Diksha’ shāstrano ekāgra chitte pāth karvo. Pāth karvā asamartha hoy temne priti-purvak tenu shravan karvu. Ane shraddhāthi te rite ācharvā prayatna karvo. (293–294)
english_translation: Satsangis should daily read this ‘Satsang Diksha’ shastra with concentration. Those who are unable to read should lovingly listen to it. Moreover, all should faithfully endeavour to practise it. (293–294)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Paramātmā Param Brahma Swāminārāyaṇo Harihi; Siddhāntam sthāpayāmāsa hyakshara-Purushottamam.
Guravash-cha Guṇātītāsh- cha-krustasya pravartanam; Virachitam idam shāstram tat-siddhāntā’nusārataha.
gujarati_transliteration: Paramatma Parabrahma Swaminarayan Bhagwane Akshar-Purushottam siddhāntni sthāpnā kari ane Gunatit guruoe tenu pravartan karyu. Te siddhānt anusār ā shāstra rachyu chhe. (295–296)
english_translation: The Akshar-Purushottam siddhānt was established by Paramatma Parabrahma Swaminarayan Bhagwan and spread by the Gunatit gurus. This shastra is written based on this siddhānt. (295–296)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Krupayaivā’vatīrṇo’tra mumukshu-moksha-hetunā; Parabrahma dayālur hi Swāminārāyaṇo bhuvi.
Sakalā’shrita-bhaktānām yoga-kshemau tathā’vahat; Vyadhāt sa dvi-vidham shreya āmushmikam tathaihikam.
gujarati_transliteration: Parabrahma dayālu Swaminarayan Bhagwan krupāe karine ja mumukshuonā moksha māte ā lokmā avtaryā. Sakal āshrit bhaktonā yoga-kshemnu vahan karyu ane ā lok tathā parlok em banne prakārnu emne kalyān karyu. (297–298)
english_translation: To grant moksha to the mumukshus, the compassionate Parabrahma Swami narayan Bhagwan manifested on this earth out of sheer grace. For all devotees who sought refuge he provided for their well-being and prosperity. He benefited them both in this world and beyond. (297–298)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sarvatraivā’bhivarshantu sadā divyāh krupā’shishaha; Paramātma-Parabrahma- Swāminārāyaṇa-Prabhoho.
gujarati_transliteration: Sarvatra Paramatma Parabrahma Swami narayan Bhagwannā divya krupāshish sadā varse. (299)
english_translation: May the divine, compassionate blessings of Paramatma Parabrahma Swaminarayan Bhagwan always shower everywhere. (299)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sarveshām sarva-dukhāni tāpa-trayam upadravāhā; Kleshās-tathā vinashyeyur agnānam sanshayā bhayam.
gujarati_transliteration: Sarvenā sarva dukho, tran tāp, upadravo, klesho, agnān, sanshayo tathā bhay vināsh pāme. (300)
english_translation: May all the grief, three types of miseries, calamities, distresses, ignorance, doubts and fears of all be destroyed. (300)

sanskrit_transliteration: Bhagavat-krupayā sarve svāsthyam nirāmayam sukham; Prāpnuvantu parām shāntim kalyāṇam paramam tathā.
gujarati_transliteration: Bhagwanni krupāthi sarve nirāmay svāsthya, sukh, param shānti tathā param kalyān pāmo. (301)
english_translation: Through Bhagwan’s grace, may all attain good health, happiness, utmost peace and ultimate moksha. (301)

sanskrit_transliteration: Na kashchit kasyachit kuryād droham dvesham tathā janaha; Sevantām ādaram sarve sarvadaiva parasparam.
gujarati_transliteration: Koi manushya koino droh tathā dvesh na kare. Sarve sadāy paraspar ādar seve. (302)
english_translation: May no one harm or hate others. May everyone always respect each other. (302)

sanskrit_transliteration: Sarveshām jāyatām prītir draḍhā nishṭhā cha nishchayaha; Vishvāso vardhatām nityam Akshara-Purushottame.
gujarati_transliteration: Akshar-Purushottamne vishe sarvane dradh priti, nishthā, nishchay thāy ane vishvās sadāy vruddhi pāme. (303)
english_translation: May everyone develop firm love, conviction and unwavering belief in Akshar-Purushottam, and may everyone’s faith forever flourish. (303)

sanskrit_transliteration: Bhavantu balinah sarve bhaktāsh-cha dharma-pālane; Āpnuyuh Sahajānanda- Parātmanah prasannatām.
gujarati_transliteration: Sarve bhakto dharma pālvāmā baliyā thāy ane Sahajanand Paramatmani prasannatā prāpta kare. (304)
english_translation: May all devotees become resolute in following dharma and attain the pleasure of Sahajanand Paramatma. (304)

sanskrit_transliteration: Prashāntair jāyatām yukto manushyair dharma-shālibhihi; Sansārah sādhanā-shīlair adhyātma-mārga-sansthitaihi.
gujarati_transliteration: Sansār prashānt, dharmavān, sādhanāshil tathā adhyātma-mārge chālnārā manushyothi yukta thāy. (305)
english_translation: May the world be filled with people who are peaceful, righteous and engrossed in spiritual endeavours, and who tread the path of spirituality. (305)

sanskrit_transliteration: Aikyam mithah suhrad-bhāvo maitrī kāruṇyam eva cha; Sahana-shīlatā snehah sarva-janeshu vardhatām.
gujarati_transliteration: Sarva manushyomā paraspar ektā, suhrad bhāv, maitri, karunā, sahanshiltā tathā sneh vruddhi pāme. (306)
english_translation: May mutual unity, suhradbhāv, friendship, compassion, tolerance and love flourish among all people. (306)

sanskrit_transliteration: Satsange divya-sambandhād Brahmaṇah Parabrahmaṇaha; Sarveshām jāyatām dārḍhyam nirdosha-divya-bhāvayoho.
gujarati_transliteration: Brahma tathā Parabrahmanā divya sambandhe karine satsangne vishe sarvane nirdoshbhāv tathā divyabhāvni dradhtā thāy. (307)
english_translation: Through the divine association of Brahma and Parabrahma, may all strengthen nirdoshbhāv and divyabhāv towards the Satsang. (307)

sanskrit_transliteration: Akshara-rūpatām sarve samprāpya svātmani janāhā; Prāpnuyuh Sahajānande bhaktim hi Purushottame.
gujarati_transliteration: Sarva jano potānā ātmāne vishe Akshar ruptā prāpta kari Purushottam Sahaj anandni bhakti prāpta kare. (308)
english_translation: May all identify their ātmā as aksharrup and offer devotion to Purushottam Sahajanand. (308)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Māghasya shukla-panchamyām ārabdham asya lekhanam; Pavitre vikramābde hi rasarshi-kha-dvi-sanmite.
Chaitra-shukla-navamyām cha Swāminārāyaṇa-Prabhoho; Tach-cha sampūrṇatām prāptam divya-janma-mahotsave.
gujarati_transliteration: Vikram Samvat 2076nā Magh shukla panchmie ā shāstra lakhvāno ārambh karyo ane Chaitra sud navmie Swaminarayan Bhagwannā divya janma- mahotsave te sampurna thayu. (309–310)
english_translation: The writing of this shastra began on Magha (Maha) sud 5 [30 January 2020 CE] of Vikram Samvat 2076 and was completed on Chaitra sud 9 [2 April 2020 CE], on the divine birthday celebration of Swaminarayan Bhagwan. (309–310)

sanskrit_transliteration:
Upāsya-Sahajānanda- Haraye Parabrahmaṇe; Mūlā’kshara-Guṇātītā nandāya Swāmine tathā.
Bhagatajī-Mahārāja- sākshād-vignāna-mūrtaye; Yagnapurushadāsāya satya-siddhānta-rakshiṇe.
Vātsalyā’rdrā’tmane nityam ānanda-brahma-yogine; Vishva-vandya-vinamrāya gurave Pramukhāya cha.
Anjalih shāstra-rūpo’yam sānandam bhakti-bhāvataha; Arpyate Pramukha-Swāmi- janma-shatābdi-parvaṇi.
gujarati_transliteration: Upāsya Parabrahma Sahajanand Shri Hari tathā Mul Akshar Gunatitanand Swami, sākshād jnān-murti samā Bhagatji Maharaj, satya siddhāntnā rakshak evā Yagnapurushdasji (Shastriji Maharaj), sadāy vātsalya-bhinā ane ānandmay brahma evā Yogiji Maharaj tathā vishva- vandya ane vinamra evā guru Pramukh Swami Maharajne ā shāstra-rupi anjali Pramukh Swami Maharajnā janma shatābdi parve sānand bhaktibhāve arpan karvāmā āve chhe. (311–314)
english_translation: On the occasion of Pramukh Swami Maharaj’s birth centenary celebrations, this shastra is being offered with joy and devotion as a tribute to: (1) Parabrahma Sahajanand Shri Hari – the focus of upāsanā, (2) Mul Akshar Gunatitanand Swami, (3) Bhagatji Maharaj – the embodiment of wisdom, (4) Yagnapurushdasji (Shastriji Maharaj) – the protector of the true siddhānt, (5) the forever affectionate and blissful embodiment of Aksharbrahma, Yogiji Maharaj and (6) Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj, who is humble and revered throughout the world. (311–314)

sanskrit_transliteration: Tanotu sakale vishve paramānanda-mangalam; Swāminārāyaṇah sākshād Akshara-Purushottamaha.
gujarati_transliteration: Swaminarayan Bhagwan etle ke sākshāt Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj sakal vishvamā param ānand-mangalne vistāre. (315)
english_translation: May Swaminarayan Bhagwan, who is Akshar-Purushottam Maharaj himself,18 spread supreme bliss and auspiciousness throughout the entire world. (315)
